items.text:
TLDR:   It is fun to me, so I recommend it.

There are design decisions i disagree with and some wasted potential. The controls and mechanics can feel clunky and there is the occasional bug / insufficient optimisation. It is clear that the game has grown over time and that the underlying architecture isn't as clean as it could be.... HOWEVER the game itself is fun, interesting and has a unique charm. It let me rip apart dozens of wrecks to overhaul and "upgrade" my own ship into the abomination of a space-brick it is today. It is one of the games where I wish there was more content to it, though given my playtime that is probably pretty pointless to say.

There are two issues that still bother me though:
1. The world (stations, ships, npcs) does not really feel alive. The npcs and their mission feel arbitrarily randomised and the stations I visited were somewhat of a let down.
2. The progression is off. You can stay around the starting area and pretty much find (almost) all types of shipparts and machines. I did not anticipate being able to spoil the late-game enjoyment of the game by "overgrinding" the starter area. Which is kind of on me, but I would have loved to know. This would be an easy fix by adding vendors and wrecks unique to other areas.... also I feel like there should be more machine-variations in general with different optimised stats. Because planning and experimenting with different parts to redo your ships design YET ANOTHER TIME is what is fun... at least to me.

The developer is active and listening and the game is being worked on. I am looking forward to future changes and even dare to hope for some of my current concerns to be eventually invalidated (which is a rare thing for me to say nowadays).
items.text_zh:
TLDR：对我来说很好玩，所以我推荐它。

有些设计决定我不同意，也有一些被浪费的潜力。操作和机制有时会感觉笨拙，偶尔还有bug/优化不足。很明显这个游戏是随着时间发展起来的，底层架构也没有它本可以有的那么干净……然而游戏本身很好玩、有趣，而且有一种独特的魅力。它让我拆解了几十艘残骸，来彻底翻修并“升级”我自己的飞船，变成今天这个太空砖头般的怪物。这是那种我希望它有更多内容的游戏之一，不过考虑到我的游玩时长，这么说大概也没什么意义。

不过还有两个问题仍然困扰我：
1. 这个世界（空间站、飞船、NPC）并不真的感觉是活的。NPC和他们的任务感觉是随意随机生成的，我去过的空间站也有点让人失望。
2. 进度曲线不对。你可以待在起始区域附近，就几乎能找到（差不多）所有类型的飞船部件和机器。我没想到自己会因为在新手区“过度刷”而破坏游戏后期的乐趣。这某种程度上是我自己的问题，但我本来很想知道这一点。这其实很容易修复，只要给其他区域添加独特的商人和残骸就行……另外我觉得总体上应该有更多机器变体，带有不同的优化属性。因为规划并试验不同部件，再一次重做你的飞船设计，才是有趣的地方……至少对我来说是这样。

开发者很活跃，也在倾听，游戏还在继续开发中。我期待未来的改动，甚至敢于希望我目前的一些担忧最终会变得不再成立（如今我很少会这么说）。

observations.description: 偶尔出现bug和优化不足。
observations.evidence: there is the occasional bug / insufficient optimisation
observations.evidence_zh: 偶尔会有bug/优化不足

items.text:
我是56人民币买的，开发者蓝瓶的大名还是在好几年前玩末日拾荒者的时候知道的，冲着开发者买的，结果玩了47小时感觉不太对劲。
首先现在这个是一款“太空模拟游戏”，而且确实没有官方中文，大家想要中文的话一定要在创意工坊订阅中文化mod，但是mod还是会有缺字和未翻译部分，这个没办法，mod制作者也很难修改。
作为太空模拟游戏，和末日拾荒者比，最大的不同就是没有“制作”功能了，虽然游戏里也有很多种材料，但是通常是用来卖钱或者维修，我们没办法从零开始建造东西，只能用各种零件修复损坏的东西。
而且太空拾荒者，真的是围绕太空飞船展开：开局我们有一艘破飞船，需要开着我们的破飞船去其他更破的飞船上打捞各种配件卖钱，开的过程相当硬核，非常建议大家到B站上找一下介绍视频。当然赚钱也可以做各种小任务，而且赚的更多。
钱赚够了，我们就要从其他的破飞船上拆下各种部件加装到我们的飞船上，建设一艘最大最强的飞船。
然后大家可以跟着steam指南里的剧情流程攻略，做一下流程任务，解锁一下成就。
再然后就没有什么了，说实话玩了这么久，就是想看看剧情，结果被一堆文字糊脸，也就是太空时代利益纠葛那些事，我们主角就是个可怜的普通人（兼职黑客大师和海盗头子）。
而且这游戏优化挺差的，玩久了每次存读档都要一大堆现实时间，而且飞船大了之后，被别的飞船打，或者核反应堆爆炸，或者什么大规模爆炸，你就等着自己卡成PPT吧。
本来是作为环世界的代餐玩的，现在还是回去玩环世界吧。
————————————————
追加，现在再次觉得，ostranauts太空拾荒者的技能系统和战斗系统属于根本没有，全部的游戏过程就是拆船-赚钱-拆船-赚钱，玩久了真的很乏味。之前的末日拾荒者属于也是没有技能系统的那一种，但是战斗系统挺有意思的，还可以制作点小玩意，太空拾荒者真的除了画面进步，其他的啥都没有感觉。。。

there are so many bugs and alot will kill your game not just be annoying .To make it wores the game is slow and you could loos a 40 hour run just like that if you can get that far . items.text_zh:
我想爱上这款游戏，因为它的背景设定在一个受《萤火虫》和《无垠的太空》等酷炫剧集启发的地方。我也完全痴迷于造船，但好的部分到此为止。

有太多bug，而且很多会直接毁掉你的游戏，不只是烦人而已。更糟的是，游戏很慢，如果你能玩到那么远的话，你可能就这样失去40小时的进度。我发现每隔几个小时就会遇到一个重大问题，不得不读档，失去时间进度再试一次。这些bug不是新的，它们从几年前一开始就存在，开发者一直没有修复它们

我为这款游戏等了多年，而它在这种状态下发布1.0，是对那些支持它的人的侮辱。我再也不会买Bluebottle Studios的任何游戏了。

observations.evidence: the game is slow
observations.evidence_zh: 游戏很慢

items.text: Very close, and could've been an incredible game - but they missed the mark. The last straw for me was the game can't function on 16x speed once you get established, so mid-game is the end of the road.

items.text:
Мне дорога моя девушка и работа важна, поэтому ради этой игры пришлось пожертвовать сном и начать спать по 4 часа в среднем.

По геймплею - то ли баротравма, то ли проект зомбоид в космосе с генами Hardspace:Shipbreaker.

Я абсолютно понимаю негативные комментарии об игре из-за которых сомневался в покупке.
Да, она несколько багованная (хотя критических я не встречал, разве что однажды случайно умер и обнаружил, что автосохранение не работало последние 3 часа)
Да, я даже не зная ничего об игре до выхода "в релиз" вижу, что авторы задумывали раз в 10 больше контента, но споткнулись об амбиции. Ну моды прикрутили и то хорошо, фанаты допилят.
Да, оптимизация местами хромает (справедливости ради играю и на калькуляторе на работе нередко и на домашнем компе, оптимизация тут не зависит от железа, длительнейшие сохранения, фризы и падения ФПС вы испытаете в любом случае)
Да, ИИ тупейший. Показательный пример: боты на станции заметили пожар и побежали его тушить. Снаружи. Даже те, у кого были скафандры - шлемы не надели. Налутал я с них знатно. Захватил пирата с баунти за голову, запер в комнате с запасом еды и воды - он всё пытался выйти наружу воспользоваться кофейным автоматом, делая по тысяче просчётов маршрута в секунду, и из-за этого у меня ФПС падал до 1-10 кадров в секунду. И подобное происходит регулярно.
Да менеджмент инвентаря обычно ад из матрёшки. 
Да, редактор персонажа странный. Предполагается, что твой персонаж будет либо рандомным, но, потенциально, сильнее. Либо такой какой ты сам соберёшь. Но через пару созданий персонажа ты понимаешь как абузить систему и сесть на два стула.
Ну и да, порог вхождения немаленький. Даже несмотря на обучение и гайды (в том числе внутриигровые)


Но господи, как же я кайфанул несмотря на это. Пилишь себе кораблики в космосе. Или восстанавливаешь. Обустраиваешь своё корыто или копишь на новое. Обычный такой космический работяга. Где-то там вокруг крутится огромный мир, который только предстоит исследовать. Накопить денег, стать дальнобоем и купить там квартиру после первого рейса? А может стать шахтёром на астероидах, говорят такая возможность тоже где-то есть? А может стать баунти-хантером? Курьером? Или спиться водкой ночуя в спальном мешке в куче окурков на флотилии? И даже для этого тебе придётся реально включить голову чтобы понять, как это всё работает! Чувствуется какой-то интерес. Жизнь, движуха.
items.text_zh:
我的女朋友对我很重要，工作也很重要，所以为了这款游戏，我不得不牺牲睡眠，开始平均每天只睡4个小时。

就玩法而言——这要么是气压创伤，要么是太空中的僵尸项目，带着《Hardspace:Shipbreaker》的基因。

我完全理解那些关于这款游戏的负面评论，正因为它们我才对购买犹豫不决。
是的，它有些bug（虽然我没遇到过什么严重的，除非有一次我意外死了，然后发现自动存档在过去3个小时里根本没工作）
是的，即使我在“正式发布”之前对这款游戏一无所知，我也能看出作者原本设想的內容要多出10倍，但被野心绊倒了。不过好歹把mod接上了，这也不错，粉丝们会把它补完的。
是的，优化在某些地方很糟糕（公平地说，我经常在工作的计算器上玩，也在家里的电脑上玩，这里的优化不取决于硬件，超长的保存时间、卡顿和帧数下降你无论如何都会遇到）
是的，AI蠢到极点。一个典型的例子：空间站上的机器人发现了火灾，然后跑去灭火。从外面。即使是那些有宇航服的——也没戴上头盔。我从它们身上搜刮了不少好东西。我抓了一个有悬赏的赏金海盗，把他锁在一个有食物和水的房间里——他一直试图出去用咖啡机，每秒进行上千次路径计算，因此我的帧数掉到了每秒1-10帧。类似的事情经常发生。
是的，物品栏管理通常是套娃式的地狱。
是的，角色编辑器很奇怪。按理说你的角色要么是随机的，但可能更强。要么就是你自己捏出来的那个。但创建过几个角色之后，你就明白怎么滥用这个系统，然后两头占便宜了。
嗯，是的，入门门槛不低。即使有教程和攻略（包括游戏内的）也一样


但是天哪，尽管如此我还是玩得太爽了。在太空里给自己造小船。或者修复。布置自己的破船，或者攒钱买新的。就是个普通的太空打工人。周围某个地方转动着一个巨大的世界，等着你去探索。攒钱，成为长途货运司机，然后跑完第一趟就在那儿买套公寓？或者成为小行星矿工，据说这种机会也在某个地方存在？或者成为赏金猎人？快递员？还是在舰队里睡在睡袋里、躺在一堆烟头中喝伏特加喝到烂醉？甚至为了做到这些，你都得真正动脑子去搞明白这一切是怎么运作的！能感觉到某种趣味。生活，活力。

items.text:
With how addicting the simulation (and the potential it motivates you with) is, it's a disappointment in the execution. 

Pathfinding errors between two ships forcing the player to babysit huge workloads instead of the creative design game I would rather play.
Walk commands that fail instead of picking a nearest location. 
Needing to look for your characters shoes because autotask (which isn't even on) ripped through some inventories on an EVA warpath. 
Triple beep error sound that has lost all its meaning by being played just because the game is paused when a valid walk command is issued. 
The massive performance hiccups that are so regular it suggests a complete lack of hardware sympathy.
Installs that wont pass because something loose is in the designated walkway tile, even though loose items don't block walkways. 
Constantly fighting with popup inventories that clearly respect no god. 
A Quick Action Bar that impressively adds more hurdle in your way by being designed like a wack-a-mole game.
A proximity alarm that wont stay muted even if you rip out the alarm module on the Nav Station you're linked to.
Have your Nav Station backwards and your ship will flip around when you undock, but not from OKLG.
Tool-tip names and portraits showing the wrong person in your crew even after they're no longer with you. 
The list goes on and on. 

Is this whole simulation just taped together with shortcuts? This game takes _way_ too much time to play for lacking so much QoL on release. The experience you give the player _is_ the whole game. You need more discipline in programming the invariants of your fundamental systems. You need a more critical eye for interaction and readability. I _want_ deep systems. I don't want to work so hard to experience them. I don't want to learn a thousand different workarounds just to play a game. I want to recommend this game but I can't recommend the experience I've had with it so far.
items.text_zh:
模拟如此令人上瘾（以及它激励你的潜力），在执行上却令人失望。

两艘船之间的寻路错误迫使玩家照看巨大的工作量，而不是我更愿意玩的创意设计游戏。
行走命令失败，而不是选择最近的位置。
需要寻找你的角色的鞋子，因为自动任务（甚至都没开启）在EVA征途中撕毁了一些库存。
三声哔哔错误音效已经失去了所有意义，因为当发出有效的行走命令时游戏暂停就会播放它。
大规模的性能卡顿如此规律，表明完全缺乏对硬件的体谅。
安装无法通过，因为指定走道格子里有松散物品，尽管松散物品不会阻挡走道。
不断与明显不尊重任何神明的弹出式库存作斗争。
一个快速操作栏，通过设计得像打地鼠游戏一样，令人印象深刻地在你前进的道路上增加了更多障碍。
一个接近警报，即使你拔掉你所连接的导航站上的警报模块，它也不会保持静音。
把你的导航站装反了，你的船在脱离对接时会翻转，但不会从OKLG。
工具提示名称和头像显示你船员中的错误人物，即使他们已经不再和你在一起。
这样的例子不胜枚举。

整个模拟是不是只是用捷径拼凑起来的？这款游戏在发布时缺乏如此多的生活质量功能，却要花费_太多_时间来玩。你给玩家的体验_就是_整个游戏。你需要更有纪律地编程你的基础系统的不变量。你需要对交互和可读性有更批判的眼光。我_想要_深度系统。我不想为了体验它们而如此努力。我不想仅仅为了玩一个游戏而学习一千种不同的变通方法。我想推荐这款游戏，但我不能推荐我迄今为止所经历的体验。

I have a love-hate relationship with this game, I like the direction, freedom to do stupid ♥♥♥♥ and suffer the consequences. Firing up my nuclear reactor cobbled up from space trash gave me tremendous amount of joy.

At the same time it desperately needs a quality of life pass, tackling the issues of terrible hauling in a game mostly about hauling, stutters, almost complete lack of feedback when for example my little dude is dying due to a heatstroke. More control over the automatic pause/unpause system would be nice, because it never seems to do what i want it to.

Still I'll probably do 90 more hours lol

items.text:
Fun for a bit but the more you play the more it's clear this isn't close to finished. this was quite clearly kicked out of early access by factors external to game development.  aka the publisher, financial reasons or the dev maybe being sick of it??

i'd call it maybe 50% done.

i spent far too much time at the starting station and now that i've gone out and explored the system it's like an empty mall

there's basically 3 functional locations and a dozen more that are empty apart from a few basic NPC's and standard services. 
CQB combat and social gameplay are virtually identical and feel completely unimplemented. they're basically press button to be friendly / not so friendly. for example flirting consists of making a single weird facial expression over and over and over and over again. and you experience that in a scrolling text field.

Crew management is like the sims with terrible AI. it's just obnoxious. when i restarted a fresh save i just didn't bother getting any more crew than the player character.

What is fun and implemented well:

- Ship navigation (RCS or torch drive) it really feels like you're steering a brick through space or a brick tied to a nuclear reactor that's throwing fusion exhaust out of the bottom.
- Ship to ship combat.  caveat: it's basically isolated to 1 location unless you go full murderhobo

What's okay

- Constructing your ship.  it works but oh dear lord is it tedious to design and modify your brick
- Mining.   it's functional and somewhat tied in with ship combat (it's a contested zone).  but not particularly amazing. it's fine.

what's bad:

- Crew control.  Half the time the autotask stops working for some inexplicable reason and you have to take care of every persons needs the sims style.  literally half of the needs are convoluted and annoying to deal with (the social needs) where 1 is almost impossible to satisfy (altruism) 
- 80% of the solarsystem is bland empty stations with nothing special to do.
- Social / CBQ combat.  it's spamming the same things over and over to achieve the desired result with little in the way of useful feedback.
- The performance is atrocious.  loading takes ages, saving takes ages, the autotask function stutters the game constantly if you make your character build something as simple as a 10x10 floor
- There's 0 quality of life.    that 10x10 floor?   you'd better have manually filled some backpacks with flooring cause otherwise your character will grab them 1 by 1 by 1.  i'm just glad there's a mod that helps with picking up 100 pieces of floor first. cause the alternative is that you basically do that manually!
items.text_zh:
玩一会儿挺有趣，但你玩得越多就越清楚这离完成还差得远。这很明显是被游戏开发之外的因素踢出了抢先体验。也就是发行商、财务原因，或者开发者可能自己都玩腻了？？

我会说它大概完成了50%。

我在起始空间站花了太多时间，而现在我出去探索了这个星系，它就像一座空荡荡的商场

基本上只有3个有功能的地点，还有十几个除了几个基础NPC和标准服务之外空空如也的地方。
室内近战和社交玩法几乎一模一样，感觉完全没有实装。它们基本上就是按按钮来表示友好/不那么友好。比如调情就是一遍又一遍又一遍又一遍地做一个奇怪的面部表情。而你是在一个滚动文本框里体验这些的。

船员管理就像AI糟糕透顶的《模拟人生》。就是很烦人。当我重开一个新存档时，我干脆懒得招募任何超出玩家角色之外的船员。

好玩且实现得不错的部分：

- 飞船导航（RCS或火炬驱动）真的感觉像是在太空中驾驶一块砖头，或者一块绑在核反应堆上、从底部喷出聚变尾焰的砖头。
- 舰对舰战斗。但有个前提：除非你彻底化身杀人狂，否则它基本上只局限于1个地点

还行的部分

- 建造你的飞船。它能用，但天哪，设计和修改你这块砖头真是太繁琐了
- 采矿。它能用，而且某种程度上和舰船战斗挂钩（那是个争夺区）。但并不是特别惊艳。还行吧。

糟糕的部分：

- 船员控制。有一半时间自动任务会因为某些莫名其妙的原因停止工作，你就得像《模拟人生》那样照顾每个人的需求。字面上一半的需求都复杂又烦人（社交需求），其中1个几乎不可能满足（利他主义）
- 太阳系的80%都是平淡空洞的空间站，没什么特别可做的。
- 社交/室内近战。就是一遍又一遍地重复同样的事情来达到想要的结果，几乎没有什么有用的反馈。
- 性能糟糕透顶。加载要花很久，保存要花很久，如果你让你的角色建造一个简单到只有10x10的地板，自动任务功能就会让游戏不断卡顿
- 生活质量改进为0。那个10x10的地板？你最好已经手动往几个背包里装好了地板材料，否则你的角色会一块一块一块地拿。我真庆幸有个mod能帮忙先捡起100块地板。因为替代方案基本上就是你得手动去做！

items.text:
Edit: added parts about social and modding.

Full of bugs, poor design around every corner, and questionable balance. Also very unique, with absolutely no alternative.

Would I play it more? Absolutely. Would I enjoy it? Probably not. That's the nature of a toxic relationship.

Now, a little bit more in depth:

[h1]Bugs.[/h1]

There are a lot. Honestly, at some point I'm not entirely sure what is a bug and what is bad design. FPS drops, script errors, physics, memory leaks, everything would be broken at some point. I liked it a lot one time when the game created all files for a save, but didn't put them into a zip archive and couldn't read this save file. Easy fix, though.

[h1]Poor design[/h1]

Well, the list would be as long as the game features. Basically, everything that you would do in this game would be made in the most stupid, time-consuming, unfun way. I'm pretty sure that AI slop would make a better design. Here is a little list of examples:

When you load the game, the splash screen with update info is right before loading. I think it doesn't block the loading itself, it's just its placement is very inconvenient.

* UI is just plain bad. All of it. Like, when you're in a helmet, it blocks your UI. Because of this, I missed a very important button for 30 hours. All bags are just a fit of tedious micromanagement. Character traits are just a long list of perks without much formatting. Visor in damage mode doesn't let you see building marks, and it's VERY NEEDED to see them in that mode. When you dock, "Match speed" and "Prox Warn" alarms are not in the dock screen, AND YOU REALLY NEED THEM IN THE DOCK SCREEN.

* Quests are just 98% plain text, without barely any choices, no scene art, not even book formatting.
AI. It's very long to describe how poor the AI in this game is, it's easy to find info on all problems with it. Let's just say they often choose death instead of being part of this game. But without jokes, many people decide to play without crew at all and not deal with AI. I guess that says a lot.

* Close-quarters combat is rudimentary. Well, it's just not fun at its core and stupid. Why the hell do people with lethal wounds in vacuum die after like 5 minutes?

* Ship building. It mostly works. But there is absolutely no dry dock in the game, so you need to do it in vacuum, and that means you need to deal with AI and micromanage them, because they can randomly stop changing batteries or O2 tanks and just die. It's also a HUGE TIME SINK. At least 15 of my playtime hours were spent waiting for things to be done.

[h1]Loot[/h1]

It's sad to say, but you will see 80-90% of loot in the first 4 hours in the starter playground. There is just barely any WOW effect, not many things to be discovered. No gold mine to strike. It's just a tedious, steady grind. This problem is tied to general economy balance. In a game about making coin by salvage and exploration, this was a HUGE LETDOWN.

[H1]Social combat/NPC dialogues [/H1]

You know, I like it on paper. I think I even grasp what you need to do for results. But there is no real explanation of the system in the game or on the internet. But in reality, it's a mesh of bad UI and poor action feedback to the player. First, why do you need to look at 3-4 different parts of the screen to see the outcome of your actions after every click? Second, why do stats jump like mad when you click on an option with a simple outcome? NPCs 80% of the time answer gibberish because they play the same system, and you also say a lot of gibberish. There's really good gameplay here, but it's buried under layers of undercooked implementations.


[h1]Balance[/h1]

Well, it's shaky at best. Economy is weird and very artificial. As I said, it's a problem tied to loot. Without interesting, varied loot, it's hard to balance the economy. So they made GIGS. So you don't need to look for 10-20k ships, you can take a gig that will pay you 30k for a VERY easy task at the ship, and you can also loot this ship. But gig payments crumble under their own weight, because they're balanced around distance. So you have delivery gigs that pay you 1500, and the same delivery gigs that pay you 10mil. So, why would I salvage anything in this game about salvaging things, when I can just travel from A to B and make 2000% more profit?

Little bit about combat balance. Imagine, you're a skilled space suit user. You're in vacuum. You have a crowbar. You feel brave and on top of your game. You have no combat experience. And your enemy is a poor space suit user. He has insomnia and is on the edge of a breakdown. He's terrified. He has a pocket knife. He's 1 level higher than you in combat. Who would win? Of course, the enemy. He will absolutely destroy you with his bare hands; he wouldn't even use the pocket knife. I guess that's fair.

[h1]Mods[/h1]
Modding community is strong for a generally low playerbase. But they mostly fix annoying and bad design and UI, but they can't fix everything. This is a job for the developer. There really shouldn't be a mod that mutes the proximity alarm when you're docked, or a mod that adds EVA suit lockers, or a mod that lets AI grab multiple items before starting to work with said items. This all should be part of the base game like yesterday.

--------

So no, I can't recommend this game to anyone. Developers shouldn't release games in such a poor state out of desperation. But yes, I would probably play it more, because this is a way of a toxic relationship.
items.text_zh:
编辑：添加了关于社交和模组的部分。

到处都是bug，每个角落的设计都很糟糕，平衡性也值得怀疑。同时它又非常独特，完全没有替代品。

我会玩得更多吗？绝对会。我会享受它吗？大概不会。这就是有毒关系的本质。

现在，再深入一点：

[h1]Bug。[/h1]

有很多。老实说，到了某个时候，我都不完全确定什么是bug，什么是糟糕的设计。帧率下降、脚本错误、物理、内存泄漏，一切都会在某个时候出问题。有一次我特别喜欢的是，游戏为一个存档创建了所有文件，但没有把它们放进zip压缩包，然后无法读取这个存档文件。不过修复很简单。

[h1]糟糕的设计[/h1]

嗯，这个清单会和游戏功能一样长。基本上，你在这个游戏里做的每件事都会以最愚蠢、最耗时、最不好玩的方式来完成。我很确定AI生成的垃圾都能做出更好的设计。这里有一个小例子清单：

当你加载游戏时，带有更新信息的启动画面就在加载之前。我觉得它不会阻止加载本身，只是它的位置非常不方便。

* UI就是纯粹的糟糕。全部都是。比如，当你戴着头盔时，它会挡住你的UI。因为这个，我错过了30个小时里一个非常重要的按钮。所有背包都只是一堆繁琐的微观管理。角色特质只是一长串没有多少格式的perk。伤害模式下的面罩不让你看到建筑标记，而在那个模式下看到它们是非常必要的。当你停靠时，“匹配速度”和“接近警告”警报不在停靠界面里，而你在停靠界面里真的非常需要它们。

* 任务98%都是纯文本，几乎没有选择，没有场景美术，甚至没有书籍排版。
AI。描述这个游戏里的AI有多糟糕需要很长时间，很容易找到关于它所有问题的信息。我们就说他们经常选择死亡，而不是成为这个游戏的一部分。但不开玩笑地说，很多人决定完全不带船员玩，不跟AI打交道。我想这说明了很多。

* 近身战斗很简陋。嗯，它的核心就是不好玩而且愚蠢。为什么在真空中受了致命伤的人会在大概5分钟后死掉？

* 飞船建造。它基本上能用。但游戏里绝对没有干船坞，所以你需要在真空中进行，这意味着你需要处理AI并微观管理他们，因为他们会随机停止更换电池或氧气罐，然后直接死掉。这也是一个巨大的时间黑洞。我至少有15个小时的游戏时间花在等待事情完成上。

[h1]战利品[/h1]

说起来很遗憾，但你会在新手游乐场的前4个小时里看到80-90%的战利品。几乎没有什么WOW效果，没有多少东西可供发现。没有金矿可挖。这只是一个乏味、稳定的刷。这个问题与总体经济平衡有关。在一个通过打捞和探索赚钱的游戏中，这是一个巨大的失望。

[H1]社交战斗/NPC对话 [/H1]

你知道，理论上我喜欢它。我想我甚至明白你需要做什么才能得到结果。但游戏里或网上都没有对这个系统的真正解释。但实际上，它是糟糕UI和对玩家行动反馈不佳的混合体。首先，为什么你每次点击后都需要看屏幕上3-4个不同的部分才能看到你行动的结果？其次，为什么当你点击一个结果简单的选项时，属性会疯狂跳动？NPC有80%的时间回答的是胡言乱语，因为他们玩的是同一个系统，你也会说很多胡言乱语。这里确实有很好的玩法，但它被层层未煮熟的实现埋没了。


[h1]平衡[/h1]

嗯，往好了说也是摇摇欲坠。经济很奇怪而且非常人为。正如我所说，这是一个与战利品相关的问题。没有有趣、多样的战利品，就很难平衡经济。所以他们做了GIGS。这样你就不需要寻找1-2万的飞船，你可以接一个GIG，在飞船上做一个非常简单的任务就能付你3万，而且你还可以打捞这艘飞船。但GIG的报酬在自身重量下崩溃了，因为它们是围绕距离来平衡的。所以你有付你1500的送货GIG，也有付你1000万的同样的送货GIG。那么，在这个关于打捞东西的游戏中，我为什么要打捞任何东西，当我可以从A旅行到B并赚取多2000%的利润时？

关于战斗平衡说一点。想象一下，你是一个熟练的太空服使用者。你在真空中。你有一根撬棍。你感到勇敢，状态极佳。你没有战斗经验。而你的敌人是一个可怜的太空服使用者。他失眠，处于崩溃边缘。他吓坏了。他有一把袖珍刀。他在战斗中比你高1级。谁会赢？当然是敌人。他会赤手空拳绝对摧毁你；他甚至不会用袖珍刀。我想这很公平。

[h1]模组[/h1]
对于一个总体玩家基数很低的游戏来说，模组社区很强大。但他们大多修复烦人和糟糕的设计与UI，但他们不能修复一切。这是开发者的工作。真的不应该有一个模组来在你停靠时静音接近警报，或者一个模组来添加EVA服储物柜，或者一个模组让AI在开始处理物品之前抓取多个物品。所有这些昨天就应该成为基础游戏的一部分。

--------

所以不，我不能向任何人推荐这个游戏。开发者不应该出于绝望而发布处于如此糟糕状态的游戏。但是的，我可能会玩得更多，因为这是一种有毒关系的方式。
系统，而且你也会说很多胡言乱语。这里确实有很好的玩法，但它被层层半生不熟的实现埋没了。

嗯，往好了说也是摇摇欲坠。经济很奇怪，而且非常人为。正如我所说，这是一个与战利品相关的问题。没有有趣、多样的战利品，就很难平衡经济。所以他们做了GIGS。这样你就不需要去找价值1万到2万的飞船，你可以接一个在飞船上完成非常简单的任务就付你3万的活儿，而且你还能搜刮这艘飞船。但任务报酬会在自身重量下崩塌，因为它们是按距离平衡的。所以你有付你1500的送货任务，也有同样的送货任务付你1000万。那么，在这个关于打捞东西的游戏里，我为什么还要打捞任何东西，当我可以直接从A到B旅行并多赚2000%的利润？

稍微说说战斗平衡。想象一下，你是一个熟练的太空服使用者。你在真空中。你有一根撬棍。你觉得自己很勇敢，状态正佳。你没有战斗经验。而你的敌人是一个可怜的太空服使用者。他有失眠症，正处在崩溃边缘。他吓坏了。他有一把袖珍小刀。他在战斗方面比你高1级。谁会赢？当然是敌人。他会赤手空拳把你彻底摧毁；他甚至不会用那把袖珍小刀。我猜这很公平。

items.text:
The idea of the game is great, i supported with early access a long ago and I returned to it with every major milestone, but very disappointed in 1.0
The problems are: there are too many things that do not work as intended or are just plain bugs.
The core loop, at the start at least, is
- find ship -> disassemble ship -> sell parts -> complain that you don't have money -> repeat

BUT
- the automated commands for disassemble, build and haul to hangar zones do not work well
> they are laggy
> they are buggy: you unistall a wall that had a power conduit in it? If you give the command Haul restricted to electrical things, the wall gets hauled in the elettrical zone of your hangar too. And so it's with a lot of other things
- After the first one or two ships you have to use the automation IA of the characters to do things, but it's simply crap as:
> it prioritize things in a non easy to undestarnd way, and there is no control over its priorities
> it's buggy: it get stuck doing the same things, it takes in game minutes to figure out what to do

Then also: it's a sci-fi building / exploring game and you have to manage your resources and keep track of items... but there is no way of knowing things like
> My ship consumes 70W, ok: which part is draining power, how can I manage that? i cannot know, and the simple answer is just power down thing MANUALLY when you dont need them. 
I'm building a spaceship, but i don't get basic logic circuits to manage it.

Like: i'm docket at port -> power down air systems or navigation or whatever.
The Fun would be building those systems and see them work or fail. If you give building capabilities then... you have to have them, you cant just have a middle ground.

I really hope they improve this basic mechanics as they really bug the the whole game which is good
items.text_zh:
这个游戏的点子很棒，我很久以前就在抢先体验阶段支持了它，并且每次重大里程碑更新我都会回来玩，但对1.0版本非常失望。
问题在于：有太多东西没有按预期运作，或者干脆就是纯粹的bug。
核心循环，至少一开始是
- 找到飞船 -> 拆解飞船 -> 卖掉零件 -> 抱怨自己没钱 -> 重复

但是
- 用于拆解、建造和搬运到机库区域的自动化命令运作得不好
> 它们很卡
> 它们有bug：你拆掉一面里面有电力导管的墙？如果你下达限制为电气物品的搬运命令，那面墙也会被搬运到机库的电气区域里。很多其他东西也是如此
- 在最初一两艘飞船之后，你必须使用角色的自动化AI来做事情，但它简直就是垃圾，因为：
> 它以一种不容易理解的方式排列优先级，而且无法控制它的优先级
> 它有bug：它会卡住反复做同样的事情，要花游戏内好几分钟才能弄清楚该做什么

然后还有：这是一款科幻建造/探索游戏，你必须管理资源并追踪物品……但根本没有办法知道诸如
> 我的飞船消耗70W，好吧：哪个部件在耗电，我该如何管理？我无法知道，而简单的答案就是在你不需要它们时手动关闭设备。
我正在建造一艘宇宙飞船，但我却拿不到用来管理它的基础逻辑电路。

比如：我停靠在港口 -> 关闭空气系统或导航或其他什么。
乐趣本应是建造这些系统并看着它们运作或失败。如果你给了建造能力，那么……你就必须拥有它们，你不能只搞个折中方案。

我真的希望他们改进这些基础机制，因为它们确实搞坏了整个游戏，而这游戏本身是好的

items.text:
1.0, but still incredibly buggy. Give it a bit.

Pretty decent storylines, or at-least what they're consisting of so far is pretty good. The game, even after 'full release' is basically Bethesda-coded, with bugs that range from minor annoyances to "I had to restart my 60 hour save because of this ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ bug." And some of the worst combat I've seen in a game like this. 

Ideas to make the game less of a misery:
-Fix the horrible bug that disables your ability to actually construct anything, despite having the tools and items to do so
-Get rid of the annoying loading splash screen (Why do we gotta' click? Just load.)
-Fix the god-awful lag/stuttering/freezing issues
-Fix the scroll-wheel's zoom rubber banding after exiting a menu.
-Fix the horrible PDA files ui
-Fix the strangely low spawn rate for Heavy Water containers.
-Make it obvious which PDA is yours in the files menu
-Make it impossible for police to warrant you when a ship's transponder is off.
-O2 tank refill auto-shutoff
-Player-placed items REMAIN the player's property. (That's my battery charger, stop arresting me because I picked it up.)
-Allow docking at stations while towing a vessel
-Make most containers on-board ships and station private property so I can't just yoink someone's weed cigs.
-Different ways of reaching other planets without having to grind for RL days to get a Torch Drive.
-More space horror
-Add the transit kiosks in a tram-like station so we aren't just teleporting to other parts of stations.
-More advancements from certain NEOScavenger plots.
- Less tedious sleep/super-fast skip mechanic
- Refined auto-task coding (No, I don't want you to stand there with an empty power drill, PUT your fully charged back-up battery in it!)
items.text_zh:
1.0，但仍然bug多得离谱。再给它点时间吧。

剧情还算不错，至少目前的内容相当可以。这游戏即使在“正式发布”之后，基本上还是贝塞斯达式的，bug从轻微烦人到“因为这个♥♥♥♥♥♥♥的bug我不得不重开我60小时的存档”都有。而且战斗是我在这种游戏里见过最糟糕的之一。

让游戏不那么痛苦的想法：
-修复那个可怕的bug，它会让你无法实际建造任何东西，尽管你有工具和物品
-去掉烦人的加载启动画面（为什么非得点一下？直接加载就行了。）
-修复那糟糕透顶的卡顿/掉帧/冻结问题
-修复退出菜单后滚轮缩放的回弹问题
-修复糟糕的PDA文件界面
-修复重水容器生成率异常低的问题
-在文件菜单里明确标出哪个PDA是你的
-让警察在飞船应答器关闭时无法通缉你
-O2罐加满后自动关闭
-玩家放置的物品保持为玩家财产。（那是我的电池充电器，别因为我把它捡起来就逮捕我。）
-允许在拖拽船只时停靠空间站
-把飞船和空间站上的大多数容器设为私有财产，这样我就不能随便顺走别人的大麻烟了
-提供不用为了弄到火炬引擎而肝现实里好几天就能到达其他星球的不同方式

items.text:
Coming as someone who ONLY played this after the 1.0 release - 

An amazing, great game. One of the best of all time maybe.
But only If you can tolerate the janky UI and total lack of documentation on what is actually a feature of the game, and what isn't.

So, why do I love it so much? Well, it's the most immersive spaceship game I've ever played. It's not just about piloting the spaceships - it's about living a simulated life *as* a spaceship captain. 

In this game, everyone, including you, needs to sleep somewhere, drink, eat, use the toilet, and socialize.

I've visited bars on the space station just to chat and flirt with random people in order to address my psychological needs. I've used coffee as a replacement for sleep, and suffered the consequences. I've engaged in idle chitchat with someone with the intention of pivoting to the subject of hiring them as crew - and succeeded. 

I've spent hours alone working on my ship, sending my needs for achievement, privacy, and security to the best they can possibly be, while my needs for socialization, belonging and intimacy tanked.

I've left the helm unattended, risking colliding with something just to get a few extra minutes of repairs in before I need to take control again. 

I've shut off alarms because they annoyed me, only to die because I forgot they were off and I didn't get the warning in time.

I've accidently left my air pumps on and didn't notice my ship was pressurized to ~50 times earth atmosphere until I started hearing metal creaking from the fusion fuel tanks inside my ship being crushed.

I've been pressed into my pilot seat by gforces from accelerating. I've had crew members fall over while they were working when I did a sudden maneuver.

I've died to fires in my ship, and I've had my life saved by my CO2 alarm going off while I was piloting. I've vented the entire cabin into space to get rid of the smoke and co2, and lived to tell about it. I've fled into the space station from a fire on my ship while docked, only to die of heat stroke, burns, and inhalation of smoke and co2.

I've accidently walked into space without a sealed suit too many times to count, and usually lived. One time I did so while working on my ship in dock, and barely made it into the pressurized station - at the end I was moving at a snails pace, on the verge of blacking out, body pressed to the absolute limits. A minute or so of rest, and I went back to work on my ship, now a little smarter.

I've subdued or killed pirates with my fists, a tactical knife, a 9mm pistol, and a katana. I've had pirates panic after shooting at them several times, even though I didn't hit them. I've sold a colt 1911 I found on a junked ship because I have no idea where to buy .45 ammo in this backwater I'm stuck on. I sold a cutlass I found because who needs one when they already have a katana.

I finally assembled a fusion reactor, and figured out how to start it. I also made a small mistake and seriously wore it out and almost exploded it. I reloaded a save game to avoid having to find a new one that hadn't been taken to the verge of ruin by a stupid newbie. Then I figured out what I did wrong, and successfully started and used the reactor without damaging it.

I've been putting things like bedrooms, bathrooms, and exercise rooms in my ship - in preparation for my first journey from this junkyard rock in the middle of nowhere, to an actual place like the cloud cities of Venus, affluent Mars, the moon (which I've been told is haunted) or the United States Military Industrial Complex, located on the moon Titan. Just some of the examples of places I could go, from The Sun, out to the Oort cloud. 81 hours in and I've barely scratched the surface!


So what's bad? Mostly the UI. 

The UI works, it tells you what you need to know, and lets you do what you need to do - but you will need to spend maybe 20 hours figuring out just the basics of what the f it's telling you, and how the f you do the things.

For the first 10-20 hours playing, if you're like me you're going to be asking yourself WTF did that just happen (haven't learned how to read the UI yet, don't know what's possible within the game),

Why did my character/this NPC do this stupid fatal thing (probably because I told it to do that stupid thing, or it wasn't actually stupid).

Why does this ship part work in this stupid way (it probably doesn't work that way, or the way it works is actually not stupid). 

Why do I have to micromanage everything all of the time! (don't have to micromanage everything all of the time, but learning how to use the install planning / orders system and the tasks system is a whole new learning experience compared to directly controlling your character).

That was my experience anyway. 

Finally, bugs. As near as I can tell everything important in the game works fine, which I consider a miracle given the scope of the game. So I don't know what all the "this game is buggy and unplayable!" people are talking about. 
 
That being said, I have experienced the following 6 things that I believe are bugs:

1. The one system I've encountered that seems flat out bugged and not working seems to be pirates surrendering - the game seems to imply I can give a surrendered pirate orders or take control of them somehow, but I've never had any control whatsoever over them. Can't even ask them to drop their weapon, frisk them, or restrain them. They do stop attacking for a while, but that's it.

2. Speaking of dumb pirates, sometimes when a pirate jumps me and docks to my vessel - instead of actually boarding me they just stay on their ship and do random tasks. Also it seems like I can just undock from forced docking? I've yet to have permission to undock refused. Seems like a bug?

3. I've also had occasional stuttering that sucks but is still playable - it seems to happen after a while playing, and goes away after quitting and reloading. 

[strike]4. The game hasn't crashed on me yet, but it does hang when I quit the game more often than not, and I have to force close. Annoying, but not game breaking in any way.[/strike] Fixed by a post release patch.

5. Sometimes the character interaction leaves me hanging at "waiting for the other person to respond". But this is relatively rare/situational and seems to resolve itself eventually. Unfortunate and I hope they fix it, but again - not unplayable.

6. Last bad thing - sometimes NPC ships ignore the speed of their ship and the limits of the human body. I didn't see this happen until relatively recently when a pirate jumped my extremely fast ship. I dodged them, outran them, out accelerated them - but then, they went from rapidly falling behind me to surging into me in an amount of time that would have turned them into goo. After killing them I observed that their ship wasn't that fast either. Devs, this sucks - please fix it.


So overall? This game has been amazing. Not broken, not unplayable. Just has a really high UI learning curve, a few non fatal technical issues, and some unfortunate bugs. Maybe all the game breaking stuff happens after the 81 hour mark?
items.text_zh:
作为一个只在1.0发布后才开始玩这款游戏的人——

一款令人惊叹的、伟大的游戏。也许是有史以来最好的游戏之一。
但前提是你能够忍受那蹩脚的UI，以及完全没有文档说明游戏中哪些是真正的功能、哪些不是。

那么，我为什么这么喜欢它呢？嗯，这是我玩过的最具沉浸感的太空飞船游戏。它不仅仅是驾驶太空飞船——而是*作为*一名太空飞船船长过着模拟生活。

在这款游戏中，每个人，包括你自己，都需要找个地方睡觉、喝水、吃饭、上厕所、社交。

我去过空间站上的酒吧，只是为了和随机的人聊天、调情，以满足我的心理需求。我用咖啡代替睡眠，并承受了后果。我和某人闲聊，意图把话题转向雇佣他们作为船员——而且成功了。

我独自花了几个小时在飞船上工作，把我的成就、隐私和安全需求提升到尽可能最好的状态，而我的社交、归属感和亲密需求却一落千丈。

我让舵位无人看管，冒着撞上什么东西的风险，只为在我需要重新掌控之前多挤出几分钟的修理时间。

我关掉了警报，因为它们烦我，结果却因为忘了它们关着、没能及时收到警告而死。

我不小心让空气泵一直开着，直到我开始听到飞船内部聚变燃料箱被压碎时金属发出的嘎吱声，才注意到飞船被加压到了约50倍地球大气压。

我被加速产生的G力压在驾驶座上。当我突然机动时，有船员在工作时摔倒。

我死于飞船上的火灾，也曾在驾驶时因二氧化碳警报响起而获救。我曾把整个舱室排空到太空中以清除烟雾和二氧化碳，并活了下来讲述这件事。我曾因停靠时飞船上的火灾而逃进空间站，结果却死于热射病、烧伤以及吸入烟雾和二氧化碳。

我不小心没穿密封服就走入太空的次数多到数不清，而且通常都活了下来。有一次我在船坞里修理飞船时这么做了，勉强进入了加压的空间站——最后我以蜗牛般的速度移动，濒临昏厥，身体被逼到了绝对极限。休息了一分钟左右，我又回去修理飞船，现在稍微聪明了一点。

我用拳头、战术刀、9毫米手枪和武士刀制服或杀死了海盗。我曾让海盗在朝他们开了几枪后惊慌失措，尽管我并没有打中他们。我卖掉了一艘废弃飞船上找到的柯尔特1911，因为我完全不知道在这个我困守的穷乡僻壤哪里能买到.45弹药。我卖掉了一把找到的弯刀，因为已经有武士刀了谁还需要它呢。

我终于组装好了一个聚变反应堆，并弄清楚了如何启动它。我也犯了一个小错误，严重磨损了它，差点把它弄爆炸。我重新加载了一个存档，以避免不得不去找一个新的、还没被某个愚蠢新手折腾到濒临报废的反应堆。然后我弄明白了自己做错了什么，并成功启动和使用了反应堆而没有损坏它。

我一直在往飞船里放卧室、浴室和健身房之类的东西——为我的第一次旅程做准备，从这个位于荒无人烟之地的废品场岩石，前往一个真正的地方，比如金星的云城、富裕的火星、月球（有人告诉我那里闹鬼）或者位于土星泰坦上的美国军工联合体。这些只是我能去的地方的一些例子，从太阳一直延伸到奥尔特云。玩了81个小时，我几乎还没触及皮毛！


那么有什么不好的呢？主要是UI。

UI能用，它会告诉你需要知道的东西，让你做需要做的事——但你可能需要花大约20个小时才能弄清楚它到底在说什么鬼东西，以及你到底该怎么做这些事。

在玩的前10到20个小时里，如果你像我一样，你会问自己这到底发生了什么（还没学会怎么看UI，不知道游戏里什么是可能的），

为什么我的角色/这个NPC做了这件愚蠢的致命事情（可能是因为我叫它做了那件蠢事，或者它其实并不蠢）。

为什么这个飞船部件以这种愚蠢的方式工作（它可能不是那样工作的，或者它的工作方式其实并不蠢）。

为什么我时时刻刻都得微观管理一切！（不必时时刻刻微观管理一切，但学习如何使用安装规划/命令系统和任务系统，与直接控制你的角色相比，是一种全新的学习体验）。

反正这就是我的经历。

最后，bug。据我所知，游戏中所有重要的东西都运行良好，考虑到游戏的规模，我认为这是个奇迹。所以我不知道那些说“这游戏bug多到没法玩！”的人在说什么。

话虽如此，我遇到过以下6件我认为是bug的事情：

1. 我遇到的唯一一个似乎彻底出bug、无法正常运作的系统，似乎是海盗投降——游戏似乎暗示我可以给投降的海盗下命令或以某种方式控制他们，但我从来没能对他们有任何控制权。甚至不能叫他们放下武器、搜身或捆绑他们。他们确实会停止攻击一段时间，但仅此而已。

2. 说到愚蠢的海盗，有时当海盗跳到我船上并停靠到我的飞船时——他们并不真正登船，而是待在自己的船上做随机任务。而且似乎我可以直接从强制停靠中脱离？我还没有被拒绝过脱离许可。看起来像个bug？

3. 我偶尔也会遇到卡顿，很烦但还能玩——似乎玩了一段时间后会出现，退出并重新加载后就消失了。

[删除线]4. 游戏还没有在我这里崩溃过，但退出游戏时它经常卡住，我不得不强制关闭。烦人，但绝不至于破坏游戏体验。[/删除线]已由发布后补丁修复。

5. 有时角色互动会让我卡在“等待对方回应”。但这相对罕见/视情况而定，而且似乎最终会自行解决。很不幸，我希望他们能修复它，但再次强调——并非无法游玩。

6. 最后一件坏事——有时NPC飞船会无视自己飞船的速度和人体极限。我直到最近才看到这种情况发生，当时一艘海盗船跳到了我极快的飞船上。我躲开了他们，跑赢了他们，加速超过了他们——但随后，他们在本应把他们变成糊状的时间内，从迅速落后于我变成猛冲撞向我。杀死他们后，我观察到他们的飞船其实也没那么快。开发者们，这很糟糕——请修复它。


所以总体而言？这款游戏一直很棒。没有坏掉，并非无法游玩。只是UI学习曲线非常高，有一些非致命的技术问题，以及一些不幸的bug。也许所有破坏游戏的东西都发生在81小时之后？
（有人告诉我那里闹鬼）或者位于土卫六上的美国军工复合体。这些只是我能去的地方的一些例子，从太阳，一直到奥尔特云。玩了81个小时，我才刚刚触及皮毛！


那么有什么不好的？主要是UI。

UI能用，它会告诉你需要知道的东西，让你做你需要做的事——但你可能需要花大约20个小时才能搞明白它到底在说什么鬼东西，以及你到底该怎么做事。

在游戏的前10-20个小时里，如果你像我一样，你会问自己这到底刚刚发生了什么（还没学会怎么看UI，不知道游戏里能做什么），

为什么我的角色/这个NPC做了这种愚蠢的致命事情（可能是因为我叫它做了那件蠢事，或者那件事其实并不蠢）。

为什么我时时刻刻都得微观管理一切！（不必时时刻刻微观管理一切，但学习如何使用安装规划/命令系统和任务系统，与直接控制你的角色相比，是一种全新的学习体验）。

反正这就是我的经历。

最后，bug。据我所知，游戏里所有重要的东西都运行良好，考虑到游戏的规模，我认为这是个奇迹。所以我不知道那些说“这游戏bug多到没法玩！”的人到底在说什么。

话虽如此，我遇到过以下6件我认为是bug的事情：

1. 我遇到的唯一一个似乎彻底有bug、无法正常运作的系统，似乎是海盗投降——游戏似乎暗示我可以给投降的海盗下命令，或者以某种方式控制他们，但我从来没能对他们有任何控制权。甚至不能叫他们放下武器、搜身或制服他们。他们确实会停止攻击一段时间，但也就仅此而已。

2. 说到愚蠢的海盗，有时候海盗跳到我船上并对接我的飞船时——他们并不实际登船，而是待在自己的船上做随机任务。而且似乎我可以直接从强制对接中脱离对接？我还没有遇到过不允许脱离对接的情况。看起来像是个bug？

3. 我偶尔还会遇到卡顿，很烦，但仍然能玩——似乎是在玩了一段时间后出现，退出并重新加载后就消失了。

[strike]4. 游戏还没有在我这里崩溃过，但在我退出游戏时，它多半会卡住，我不得不强制关闭。很烦，但无论如何都不算破坏游戏体验。[/strike] 已由发布后补丁修复。

5. 有时候角色互动会让我卡在“等待对方回应”。但这相对罕见/视情况而定，而且似乎最终会自行解决。很不幸，我希望他们能修复它，但再说一次——不是没法玩。

6. 最后一件坏事——有时候NPC飞船会无视自己飞船的速度和人类身体的极限。我直到最近才看到这种情况发生，当时一艘海盗船跳到了我那艘极快的飞船上。我躲开了他们，跑赢了他们，加速度也超过了他们——但随后，他们从迅速落在我后面，变成在短时间内猛冲撞向我，那种加速度本会把它们变成一滩烂泥。杀了他们之后，我观察到他们的飞船其实也没那么快。开发者们，这很糟糕——请修复它。


所以总体而言？这款游戏一直很棒。没有坏掉，不是没法玩。只是UI学习曲线真的很高
曲线，一些非致命的技术问题，以及一些不幸的bug。也许所有破坏游戏的东西都发生在81小时之后？

observations.description: 游玩一段时间后出现卡顿，重启后消失
observations.evidence: I've also had occasional stuttering that sucks but is still playable - it seems to happen after a while playing, and goes away after quitting and reloading
observations.evidence_zh: 我偶尔也会遇到卡顿，虽然很烦但还能玩——似乎是在玩了一段时间后出现，退出并重新加载后就消失了

items.text:
The game's engine creaks beneath its own weight, but the concept is compelling - space is big and uncaring, you are small and prone to dying due to hypoxia, and the game will do its best to simulate everything surrounding the two meeting. Salvage has its excitement and shipbuilding's results are undeniably satisfying, even if the process is agonizingly clunky. Given the game's promise I had been quite content to patiently watch it slowly develop as the years rolled by. Some day the AI would no longer be a narcoleptic mess, the UI would no longer be the biggest adversary, and the game would, y'know, [i]work[/i]. No more crashes or grinding lag from one of a dozen different things breaking in the background.

Then I got the announcement that the game had hit 1.0 and full release! 🚀 Waow, exciting!

I [i]broke into laughter[/i] at the absurdity of it. I have no idea what must have possessed Blue Bottle to release if not desperation, but if so they're certainly not copping to it. From the patchnotes released today: "[b]While we figured there would be [i]some[/i] pain points revealed with launch, I think we significantly underestimated just how many there were.[/b]" Given I knew that full-well as a simple player, I cannot fathom how the game's developers could be surprised. Rather, it reads to me as 'sorry you're so mad,' and the gall of it is part of what motivated me to write up this review in the first place.

The game's release as what purports to be a full 1.0 product is disingenuous at best, and gives me great pause with respect to the odds of the continued support of the game and its prospect of ever [i]actually[/i] being finished, rather than remaining a janky mess. I'm still content to wait the years I think it will take to get it there, but I'm no longer confident that will come to pass. New players should know what to expect when buying in, and it is definitively [i]not[/i] a finished, polished experience.
items.text_zh:
这游戏的引擎在自己重压下吱嘎作响，但概念很吸引人——太空浩瀚而冷漠，你渺小且容易因缺氧而死，游戏会尽力模拟两者相遇时周围的一切。打捞有其刺激感，造船的成果无可否认地令人满足，即便过程笨拙得令人痛苦。鉴于游戏的承诺，多年来我一直很满足于耐心地看着它慢慢开发。总有一天，AI 不会再是一团嗜睡症般的烂摊子，UI 不会再是最大的对手，游戏会，你懂的，[i]正常运作[/i]。不再有崩溃，也不再有后台十几个东西中某一个坏掉导致的卡顿延迟。

然后我看到了游戏达到 1.0 正式发布的公告！🚀 哇，真令人兴奋！

我[i]笑出了声[/i]，因为这事太荒谬了。我不知道是什么驱使 Blue Bottle 发布，如果不是绝望的话，但如果是的话，他们肯定不会承认。从今天发布的补丁说明来看：“[b]虽然我们料到发布时会暴露出[i]一些[/i]痛点，但我认为我们严重低估了痛点的数量。[/b]”既然我作为一个普通玩家都对此心知肚明，我无法理解游戏开发者怎么会感到惊讶。相反，在我看来这读起来像是‘抱歉你这么生气’，而其中的厚颜无耻正是促使我写下这篇评测的部分原因。

游戏以号称完整 1.0 产品的形式发布，往好了说是虚伪，往坏了说让我对游戏持续支持的可能性以及它是否[i]真正[/i]能完成、而不是继续一团糟的前景深感疑虑。我仍然愿意等待我认为需要数年才能达到那一步，但我不再确信那会实现。新玩家在购买时应该知道会面临什么，而这绝对[i]不是[/i]一次完成、打磨过的体验。

observations.description: 后台问题导致卡顿
observations.evidence: grinding lag from one of a dozen different things breaking in the background
observations.evidence_zh: 后台十几样东西里随便哪个出问题都会造成的折磨人的卡顿

items.text:
Absolutely love the game, 50 hours in and so much is left to do.
This game is definitely worth your money and your time.

While there are many bugs, I still enjoyed so many hours without encountering game breaking stuff.

One things that bugs me the most is perdormance. The game comes to a complete halt at around 1 frame per 3 seconds when building/repairing large amount of stuff in a NPC heavy environment (OKLG).
Outside of that station or others is fine and the game run smoothly although hot.
My solution for now is limiting the game to 60fps prevent my PC to heat too much. 

I am still around the beginner area because there is so much to do.
From salvaging systems, dismantling other and hauling all kind of materials to repair my ships, I managed to flip successfully several derelict and I am free of mortgage!
The satisfaction it gave me is surreal.

The fact that mods are also supported makes this game even more awesome!
items.text_zh:
绝对喜欢这个游戏，玩了50个小时，还有那么多事情要做。
这个游戏绝对值得你的钱和时间。

虽然有很多bug，但我仍然享受了这么多小时而没有遇到破坏游戏的东西。

最让我烦的一件事是性能。在NPC密集的环境（OKLG）中建造/修理大量东西时，游戏会完全停滞，大约每3秒1帧。
在那个空间站或其他地方之外还好，游戏运行流畅，虽然很热。
我目前的解决方案是把游戏限制在60fps，防止我的PC过热。

我仍然在 beginner 区域附近，因为有太多事情要做。
从打捞系统、拆解其他东西并拖运各种材料来修理我的飞船，我成功翻新了几艘废弃船，而且我没有抵押贷款了！
它给我的满足感是超现实的。

模组也受到支持这一事实让这个游戏更加棒了！

items.text:
I really don't like giving a negative review here, but as someone who enjoyed the world, writing, and complexity of Neo Scav (despite some rough areas), I really wanted to see Blue Bottle pull through on another game.
The game is a mix of the roleplay and sandbox of Rimworld, and the complexity of a space simulation game (building, wiring, piloting, etc).
It mainly just doesn't scratch any 'fun' itch, especially between the complexity of the world, the tile based structures, and the unintuitive and uninformative UI/controls.
The game, at this stage, doesn't even have error messages for WHY I'm unable to complete some tasks (like the tutorial wire installation on the spawn station), or trying to buy things without enough money.
It just seems too big of a sim to have any easy fun with it, too laggy as well,... just seemingly lacking good scope or direction beyond the space sim itself. I wouldn't recommend it to Neo Scav fans, as it's too different, in my quiet opinion.
items.text_zh:
我真的很不想在这里给出差评，但作为一个喜欢 Neo Scav 的世界、文本和复杂性的人（尽管有些粗糙之处），我真的很希望 Blue Bottle 能在另一款游戏上挺过来。
这款游戏混合了 Rimworld 的角色扮演和沙盒，以及太空模拟游戏的复杂性（建造、布线、驾驶等）。
它主要就是挠不到任何“好玩”的痒处，尤其是在世界的复杂性、基于格子的结构，以及不直观又缺乏信息的 UI/操作之间。
在这个阶段，游戏甚至没有错误提示来说明我为什么无法完成某些任务（比如在出生站安装教程里的电线），或者钱不够时想买东西。
它似乎作为一个模拟来说太大了，很难轻松地从中获得乐趣，也太卡了，……似乎除了太空模拟本身之外就缺乏好的范围或方向。以我个人的浅见，我不会把它推荐给 Neo Scav 的粉丝，因为它太不一样了。

observations.description: 游戏太卡
observations.evidence: too laggy as well
observations.evidence_zh: 而且还太卡了

items.text:
[h1]Ostranauts - świetny szkielet, który wciąż czeka na właściwą grę[/h1]

Gra kusi obietnicami wysokiego poziomu symulacji i ciekawymi metodami budowania statków kosmicznych. Ale czy tych obietnic dotrzymuje?

[b]Poniekąd tak.[/b]

Można spędzić wiele godzin na szukaniu wartych splądrowania wraków, sprzedawaniu komponentów, byle tylko starczyło na hipotekę, a kiedy ma się już trochę pieniędzy - na ulepszaniu swojego okrętu. Tworzymy wtedy jakiś nieboży amalgamat posklejany z dziesiątek innych statków.

Po drodze robimy małe śledztwa detektywistyczne, aż w końcu dochodzimy do momentu, w którym możemy flipować gruzy z dużym zyskiem. A jeśli dobrze się postaramy, znajdzie się nawet miejsce na własny reaktor fuzyjny.

I trzeba przyznać - [b]samo robienie tego jest całkiem ciekawe.[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Problem zaczyna się wtedy, kiedy już zrobimy to, co mieliśmy zrobić[/h2]

[b]Po co?[/b]

I to jest największa bolączka, jaką mam z tą grą. [i]Ostranauts[/i] to po prostu bardzo dobry szkielet symulacji kosmicznej, ale mam wrażenie, że na tym szkielecie wciąż brakuje właściwej gry.

Postawiłeś reaktor i odblokowałeś podróż międzyplanetarną? Spoko. Tylko po co właściwie wybierać się na inne planety? Podróż trwa kupę czasu, nie wiesz, co tam zastaniesz, musisz wcześniej przygotować odpowiednie kwatery i zapasy, a ostatecznie raczej nie czeka tam na ciebie nic przełomowego.

Interakcje społeczne są dość kiepskie. Jeśli chcesz, żeby ktoś został twoim przyjacielem, to w zasadzie wystarczy wystarczająco długo z nim gadać. A kiedy już jesteście przyjaciółmi - co dalej? Nic specjalnego. Może trochę łatwiej da się go zwerbować czy coś, ale o załodze jeszcze za chwilę.

Ulepszyłeś statek, masz fajne silniki i sporo paliwa, więc możesz podróżować dalej. Tylko co z tego? Nie spotykasz lepszych wraków ani szczególnie ciekawych przeszkód.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Piraci i konsekwencje (a raczej ich brak)[/h2]

Czasami na wraku można spotkać pirata. Swoją drogą, pirat siedzący zupełnie sam na wraku, bez zadokowanego własnego statku, rodzi pytanie:

[b]Co on tam w ogóle robi?[/b]

Takiego pirata można bez większych problemów rozwalić. Ale załóżmy, że nasza postać nie jest maszyną do zabijania i chcemy go oszczędzić. Nokautujesz go i zabierasz na swój statek. Po chwili delikwent wstaje i mimo że jest bezbronny, rzuca się na ciebie i każe oddawać fanty.

Więc jaka jest opcja na rozprawienie się z piratami?

[b]Wystrzelenie ich w otchłań kosmosu.[/b]

Nasza postać oczywiście w żaden sposób nie przeżywa traumy związanej z odebraniem komuś życia.

Można również werbować załogę, ale wydawanie rozkazów jednej postaci było już wystarczająco toporne, a większa załoga jest bardzo kosztowna - zarówno jeśli chodzi o pieniądze w grze, jak i o twój komputer.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Performance[/h2]

[b]Jasny gwint.[/b]

Czy ta gra działa na jednym wątku, czy o co tutaj chodzi?

Załóżmy, że dokujesz do średniej wielkości wraku. Najpierw wydajesz rozkaz, żeby twój ludzik zdemontował 20 ścian i podłóg. Odpalasz prędkość x16. Czasem chrupnie, ale jakoś to idzie.

Potem wydajesz rozkaz, żeby utworzyć nowe pomieszczenie na swoim statku. Rozkładasz siatkę podłogi i dookoła stawiasz ściany.

[b]I jest koniec.[/b]

Nie wiem, czy logika dostarczania przedmiotów sprawdza każdą kratkę twojego statku i wraku, ale ściny są momentami nierealne. Jeśli chcesz postawić 20 podłóg, wygląda to tak, jakby wszystkie kratki były sprawdzane 20 razy, a kiedy gra już wszystko przemieli, nagle jest OK.

A mówimy tutaj o pomieszczeniu 4×5. Co się stanie, jeśli ktoś będzie chciał zbudować pomieszczenie 20×10?

Do tego dochodzą długie loadingi i głupie AI. Potrzebujesz pięciu takich samych przedmiotów? Zamiast podnieść cały stack pięciu, postać woli zrobić pięć osobnych wycieczek.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Świat[/h2]

Niestety świat jest również bardzo pusty i sprawia wrażenie makiety.

Na stacji kosmicznej zawsze jesteś jedynym zadokowanym statkiem. Nigdy nie zobaczysz NPC-a, który przyleci, zadokuje albo odleci. Jeśli podlecisz do wraku, do którego NPC już zadokował, to ten NPC faktycznie tam będzie - ale nic nie robi.

Możesz więc po prostu ograbić wrak, a on nawet nie zwróci na ciebie uwagi.

Jeszcze lepiej jest, kiedy przylecisz do miejscówki piratów i wymontujesz istotny dla tamtejszego reaktora komponent. Nikt nie zareaguje. Możesz po prostu zabrać go na swój statek i odlecieć.

To wszystko sprawia, że świat wygląda bardziej jak zbiór scenariuszy przygotowanych specjalnie dla gracza niż żywe miejsce, w którym faktycznie coś się dzieje.

[hr][/hr]

[h2]I mimo wszystko… polecam[/h2]

[i]Ostranauts[/i] ma [b]bardzo dużo niedociągnięć[/b]. I mimo całej tej krytyki [b]polecam grę[/b].

Nie widziałem jeszcze całej zawartości gry - nie dotarłem do eksploracji planet, asteroid miningu ani części endgame'u, więc nie będę udawał, że oceniam całość.

Przez [b]41 godzin[/b], które w niej spędziłem, byłem naprawdę pochłonięty. Jest tutaj sporo rzeczy do robienia, a samo budowanie, ulepszanie i kombinowanie ze statkiem potrafi dać mnóstwo satysfakcji.

Uważam jednak, że obecny poziom ukończenia wskazuje bardziej na [b]bardzo dobry Early Access niż na finalny produkt[/b].

Dałbym tej grze jeszcze rok albo dwa rozwoju. Będę śledził newsy i czekał na duży update.

[b]Na ten moment: polecam, ale z zastrzeżeniami.[/b]
items.text_zh:
[h1]Ostranauts——一副出色的骨架，却仍在等待真正的游戏[/h1]

游戏以高度模拟和有趣的太空飞船建造方式为诱饵。但它真的兑现了这些承诺吗？

[b]某种程度上是的。[/b]

你可以花很多小时寻找值得搜刮的残骸、出售部件，只为凑够抵押贷款，而当你已经有点钱时——就用来升级自己的飞船。这时我们会造出一个由数十艘其他飞船拼凑而成的不伦不类的混合体。

一路上我们会做些小小的侦探调查，直到最终到达可以高利润倒卖废墟的阶段。如果我们足够努力，甚至还能给自己的聚变反应堆找到一席之地。

而且必须承认——[b]做这件事本身相当有趣。[/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]问题始于我们做完本该做的事之后[/h2]

[b]为了什么？[/b]

这就是我对这款游戏最大的痛点。[i]Ostranauts[/i]只是一个非常好的太空模拟骨架，但我感觉这个骨架上仍然缺少真正的游戏。

你装好了反应堆，解锁了行星际旅行？不错。但究竟为什么要去其他行星？旅程要花很长时间，你不知道那里会遇到什么，必须提前准备好合适的舱室和补给，而最终那里大概也不会有什么突破性的东西等着你。

社交互动相当糟糕。如果你想让某人成为你的朋友，基本上只要跟他聊得足够久就行。而当你们已经是朋友之后——然后呢？没什么特别的。也许招募他会稍微容易一点之类的，但关于船员的事待会儿再说。

你升级了飞船，有了不错的引擎和大量燃料，所以你可以航行得更远。可那又怎样？你不会遇到更好的残骸，也不会遇到特别有趣的障碍。

[hr][/hr]

[h2]海盗与后果（或者说根本没有后果）[/h2]

有时在残骸上会遇到海盗。顺带一提，一个海盗孤零零地坐在残骸上，没有自己的飞船停靠在那里，这引出一个问题：

[b]他到底在那儿干什么？[/b]

这样的海盗可以毫无困难地干掉。但假设我们的角色不是杀人机器，我们想饶他一命。你把他打晕并带回自己的飞船。过了一会儿，这家伙站起来，尽管手无寸铁，却扑向你，要你交出财物。

那么对付海盗的选项是什么？

[b]把他们射进宇宙深渊。[/b]

我们的角色当然丝毫不会因为夺走他人性命而遭受创伤。

也可以招募船员，但指挥一个角色就已经够笨拙了，而更大的船员队伍非常昂贵——无论是游戏里的钱，还是你的电脑。

[hr][/hr]

[h2]性能[/h2]

[b]我的天。[/b]

这游戏是单线程运行的吗，还是怎么回事？

假设你停靠在一艘中等大小的残骸上。首先你下令让你的小人拆掉20面墙和地板。你开启x16速度。有时会卡一下，但勉强还能进行。

然后你下令在自己的飞船上建造一个新房间。你铺开地板网格，在四周竖起墙壁。

[b]然后就完了。[/b]

我不知道物品运送逻辑是否检查了你飞船和残骸的每一个格子，但墙壁有时慢得不真实。如果你想铺20块地板，看起来就像所有格子都被检查了20遍，而当游戏终于把所有东西处理完时，突然就OK了。

而我们说的
这里说的是4×5的房间。如果有人想建造一个20×10的房间，会发生什么？

再加上漫长的加载时间和愚蠢的AI。你需要五个相同的物品？角色宁愿跑五趟单独的来回，也不愿一次拿起整叠五个。

[hr][/hr]

[h2]世界[/h2]

不幸的是，这个世界也非常空旷，给人一种模型布景的感觉。

在空间站里，你永远是唯一停靠的飞船。你永远不会看到NPC飞来、停靠或飞走。如果你靠近一个NPC已经停靠的残骸，那个NPC确实会在那里——但什么也不做。

所以你可以直接洗劫残骸，而它甚至不会注意到你。

更妙的是，当你飞到海盗的地盘，拆下对那里反应堆至关重要的组件时。没有人会做出反应。你可以直接把它搬上自己的飞船然后飞走。

这一切让这个世界看起来更像是一堆专门为玩家准备的场景集合，而不是一个真正有事情发生的活生生的地方。

[hr][/hr]

[h2]尽管如此……我还是推荐[/h2]

[i]Ostranauts[/i]有[b]非常多的不足之处[/b]。尽管有这么多批评，[b]我还是推荐这款游戏[/b]。

我还没有看完游戏的全部内容——我还没到行星探索、小行星采矿或终局部分，所以我不会假装自己在评价整体。

在我投入的[b]41个小时[/b]里，我真的非常投入。这里有很多事情可做，光是建造、升级和折腾飞船就能带来极大的满足感。

不过我认为，目前的完成度更像是一个[b]非常优秀的抢先体验版，而不是最终成品[/b]。

我会再给这款游戏一到两年的开发时间。我会关注新闻，等待大型更新。

[b]目前来说：推荐，但有保留意见。[/b]

items.text:
why is this game even fully released?

i spent like first 200hrs of my entire playtime on waiting for stutterings, guessing if this is bug or not and screaming at the monitor like a mad man. 
this game doesnt even have good content or ai system. no career options, no social system, no real consequences for crimes, and combat is too easy. and most of the skills in the games r not even implemented yet so there is no reason to choose them in character creation. every new game is the same and actually, the only reason u have to make a new game is because the incompetence of developers who keep updating the game every week and it causes the save file more problems and mod community tired.

the game advertises hiring crew and using gun is a fun thing to do. sounds fantastic? u can have ur own private army, pirate ship or mercenaries. and there r npcs with gun skills and u can start with gun skill actually.
however, these gun skills r not even implemented in the game. and they r not even acquirable during the game. weird right? if u shoot a lot enough, u should be able to hit something at some point. but player keep shooting themselves even with the gun skill. also most of the pirates carry empty hand guns and npcs do not carry rifles even tho guns r really cheap and they sell them in bulk in space station.

i asked the developer directly, why r u guys not fixing these gun skill problems? and he said, combat is not our priority. huh? so they r admitting they just false advertised one of the core game mechanicism?

also even after the full release, crew had ai problem that they just didnt work properly. so most of the players just didnt hire anyone and played the game without the feature. so i would call this game just a slop and a scam. considering that this game has been in a development for like idk a decade? and most of the space stations in the game arent even connected to other stations even tho they have subways? 

lack of content, false advertisement, repetitive gameplay and just insult to a gaming community for fully releasing the game
items.text_zh:
这游戏到底凭什么算正式发布了？

我整个游戏时间的前200小时左右，都花在等待卡顿、猜测这是不是bug，以及像个疯子一样对着显示器尖叫上。
这游戏甚至没有好的内容或AI系统。没有职业选择，没有社交系统，犯罪没有真正的后果，战斗也太简单了。而且游戏里大多数技能甚至都还没实装，所以角色创建时根本没有理由去选它们。每一局新游戏都一样，实际上，你之所以要开新档，唯一原因就是开发者无能，他们每周都在更新游戏，结果给存档文件带来更多问题，还让mod社区疲惫不堪。

游戏宣传说雇佣船员和使用枪械是件有趣的事。听起来很棒吧？你可以拥有自己的私人军队、海盗船或雇佣兵。而且还有具备枪械技能的NPC，你实际上也可以以枪械技能开局。
然而，这些枪械技能甚至都没在游戏里实装。而且它们在游戏过程中也无法获得。很奇怪吧？如果你开枪开得足够多，总该在某个时候能打中点什么吧。但玩家即使有枪械技能也还是会打到自己。此外，大多数海盗都带着空的手枪，NPC也不携带步枪，尽管枪械真的很便宜，而且空间站里还成批出售。

我直接问过开发者，你们为什么不修复这些枪械技能问题？他说，战斗不是我们的优先事项。哈？所以他们是在承认，他们只是虚假宣传了游戏的核心机制之一？

而且即使在正式发布之后，船员仍有AI问题，他们就是不能正常工作。所以大多数玩家干脆谁也不雇，在没有这个功能的情况下玩游戏。所以我会把这游戏称为一坨烂货和一场骗局。考虑到这游戏已经开发了大概，我也不知道，十年？而且游戏里大多数空间站甚至都没有和其他空间站连接起来，尽管它们有地铁？

内容匮乏、虚假宣传、玩法重复，简直就是对游戏社区的侮辱，居然还正式发布了这游戏

items.text:
if you like NeoScavenger's mechanics, you're gonna love this.

if you wanted a bigger sandbox than NeoScavenger, this is it.

it's jank as hell just like NeoScavenger, but it's real real fun.

I'm just about to build a fusion reactor, haven't done long trips yet, enjoying scavving in the boneyard and killing pirates as they jump me. no ship combat yet, I haven't gotten any weapons for it (but also thankfully don't face any).

excellent chillout game with very crunchy arcade-simulation mechanics. like you don't need to worry about where you put thrusters, just that you have enough to move the mass of your ship.

similarly, fusion reactors aren't as insane to set up as they seem. 

although navigation/docking can be tedious, but once you get the hang of it, it's not so bad (i.e. just like everything in NeoScavenger)

if you really want, there are mods/debug commands to fully customize the game, but I'm enjoying the hell out of a vanilla legit playthrough (after a few false starts anyway).

only thing is, unlike NeoScavenger, your character *starts out* with negative traits that you actually want to remove. if you don't they'll have a worse time in combat later, but ofc, you can also have *other* people do the combat for you.

I only started playing this with 1.0 so maybe a lot was fixed because while there's jank (and there are DEFINITELY dips in fps due to this game, not my rig, but it's just like skipping here and there briefly when I issue 100s of tasks to scrap a ship) it's absolutely playable and there's quite a bit to dig into, insofar as the sandbox aspect goes.

the quests and NPCs are a little busted to some degree, and it's *very* tedious to build out a ship in-game (at least based on my understanding of how tasks work since it's not to the level of Rimworld in terms of controlling your sims) but once you get past it and embrace it, again, great chillout game while you build a ship and go scavving. haven't evne touched the bounties or long-hauling yet, but I did find a lot of neat little lore pieces and stuff from random ships.
items.text_zh:
如果你喜欢NeoScavenger的机制，你一定会爱上这个。

如果你想要一个比NeoScavenger更大的沙盒，就是这个了。

它和NeoScavenger一样粗糙得要命，但真的真的很好玩。

我正要建造一个聚变反应堆，还没进行过长途旅行，很享受在骨场拾荒，以及在海盗跳出来袭击我时干掉他们。还没有飞船战斗，我还没拿到任何武器（但谢天谢地也没遇到任何战斗）。

极佳的放松游戏，有着非常硬核的街机模拟机制。就像你不需要担心把推进器放在哪里，只需要有足够的推力来移动你飞船的质量。

同样，聚变反应堆的设置并不像看起来那么疯狂。

虽然导航/对接可能很繁琐，但一旦你掌握了窍门，就没那么糟了（也就是说，就像NeoScavenger里的一切一样）

如果你真的想，有模组/调试命令可以完全自定义游戏，但我正尽情享受一个原版正统的通关流程（在几次失败的开局之后）。

唯一的问题是，与NeoScavenger不同，你的角色*一开始*就带有你实际上想要移除的负面特质。如果你不移除，他们之后在战斗中会更惨，但当然，你也可以让*其他*人替你战斗。

我是在1.0版本才开始玩这个的，所以也许很多问题已经被修复了，因为虽然有粗糙之处（而且这游戏绝对会导致帧率下降，不是我的机器的问题，但就像当我下达数百个拆解飞船的任务时，会时不时短暂卡顿一下），它绝对可以玩，而且就沙盒方面而言，有相当多内容可以深入挖掘。

任务和NPC在某种程度上有点崩坏，而且在游戏内建造一艘飞船*非常*繁琐（至少基于我对任务运作方式的理解，因为它在控制你的模拟角色方面还达不到Rimworld的水平），但一旦你克服了这一点并接受它，再次强调，在你建造飞船和外出拾荒时，这是一款很棒的放松游戏。甚至还没碰过赏金任务或长途运输，但我确实从随机飞船中发现了许多有趣的小背景故事和东西。

items.text:
Here to offset some of the negative reviews.

I'm a new player to 1.0, and so far the experience has been absolutely fantastic. This game scratches the same itch that Neoscavanger did for me, so the developer has knocked it out of the park. The tutorial is great for learning how to play (I thought it would be impossible to learn, especially after making the mistake of opening the manual first, but honestly it's all pretty straight forward)

There's something special about this game. I have no idea why or how, but I'll sit there for 2 or 3 hours just THINKING, planning, observing, and taking it all in. Even though I literally didn't do anything, I still feel accomplished. It's similar to factorio in that way.

All in all, absolutely worth the price, and I'm not sure where the controversy of the 1.0 comes from (seeing as I'm coming in after it). Game runs fine, it hiccups when I tell my person to start 30+ jobs at once, which isn't a problem, and I'm not experiencing any crashing/bugs. Maybe I will eventually, and I'll update my review if I do, but until then it's an easy recommend.
items.text_zh:
来这里抵消一些负面评价。

我是1.0的新玩家，到目前为止体验绝对棒极了。这款游戏满足了我当年玩Neoscavanger时同样的渴望，所以开发者真是干得漂亮。教程对学习怎么玩很有帮助（我本以为会不可能学会，尤其是在犯了先打开手册这个错误之后，但说实话，一切都挺直白的）

这款游戏有种特别的东西。我不知道为什么、也不知道怎么会这样，但我会坐在那里2、3个小时，只是思考、规划、观察，并吸收这一切。尽管我实际上什么都没做，我仍然感到很有成就感。在这一点上它和factorio很像。

总而言之，绝对值这个价，而且我不确定1.0的争议从何而来（毕竟我是在它之后才来的）。游戏运行良好，当我让我的人同时开始30多个工作时它会卡顿，这不算问题，而且我没有遇到任何崩溃/bug。也许最终会遇到，如果遇到了我会更新我的评测，但在那之前，它很容易推荐。

items.text:
[h1]A game that tries to become something it will never be.[/h1]

 [b]WARNING[/b]: [i]Everything said below is a part of my subjective opinion; I may OverEstimate the game idea in some parts of my review or even imply devs are having some 4D-super-strategy-moves mumbo-jumbo; it's okay. That's the part of my impressions I received from the game after I actually started to play it DEEP.[/i]


I've seen various games... Haven't touched some of them, but definitely seen.
Some of them specialised on LSS maintaining like Stationeers.
Some - on how you build, fly and fight on your ships like Space Engineers or Empyrion.
Some - on the travel and (fast)looting aspect, like Pulsar:LC, Duskers or Scavenger SV-4 
Some - on the paranormal/thrilling stuff like VotV or Isolated Inhale...
I also enjoyed the Sunless Sea as well as it's sequel Sunless skies... 
And there was also an specimen of those so-called "Perfect sims" in the face of Shadow of Doubt...

So, the reason why I named all of those games here is because sometimes it's hard to implement even ONE of those aspects, even if you know what you're doing, yet the Devs of this game, without much of appropriate experience, still decided to try and Combine all of those things in a one...

[i]Blue. Bottle.[/i]


Honestly, I've been writing this review for more than two weeks for sure, but I'm still not sure I'll be able to fully convey my dissapointment with...
Ugh... let's say - EVERYTHING.

And the most tragic about that is the fact it's not a fault of bad code (maybe?), questionable choices (perhaps?), or attitude towards the project itself (not at... all? I guess).
Everything bad comes from the game itself... literally because of how it's imagined by design; let me explain...
Do you know what the Ouroboros is? Yeah, the self-eating snake, which can't actually eat itself yada-yada, well... This game is literally It. 
Except it DOES devour itself very vell... And first, let me tell how you will pass your gameplay time in this game:
First 30 minutes would be good, everything will be fast and easy as a light...
Then comes second 30 munites... And you'll start to notice slight issues - microlags, few seconds "to think", stuttering while accelerated...
Then comes the rubicon - At one with a half hours game will be hard to play... slow, sometimes freezing...
And eventually it grinds down to a halt. You find yourself staring at the game that spends ten minutes in "not responding" state for each minute of "responding"... And eventually you just kill the process, wait ten seconds, restart the game(Probably along with restarting half of your apps, because as Game keeps devouring your Ram way past the 12 out of 16Gb, your PC WILL begin to freak out and try to lighten the load by putting everything "not used" into the "halted" state, Steam Included.) and the cycle begins anew.

"Why it's like that? How can we fix it? Why Devs won't fix it?" - You probably asked those questions, and looking into the resmon won't help your curious mind, not unless you read the logs.
Yep, the "Perfect-Sim" ambitions they sacrificed everything else for came back to bite their ass off.

So... Do you remember how you created a character? Unless you instantly hit "seek ship", picked The Retrofit and got out of CharGen (Towards your death, if that's your second char. Or Glory - if you're Professional.) - Game usually spits out a pack of an NPCs related to your aging-up shenanigas... Snobs, Cops, Thugs, Nitwits... Friends or Foes, an "Full deck" if short.
And guess what? Each spawned NPC somewhat DO pass through the same procedure! No, they're not autistically look into the mirror (that has last time seen the janitor probably the moment it got manufactured) like you... 
Yet they do get "rolled" life... And a Buckshot of sidekicks as well! And they also get their own... and again an again an again, until they hit some kind of a limiter, But (Yes there's a persky "But"! Probably an whole gang of "But"s!) it seems this "limiter" works... let's say sometimes (s)he(?) takes a [strike]day off[/strike] full maternity leave - NPCs occasionally multiply like a rabbits, which devoured a whole crate of "Adult chems"... you know (And if you don't... Why the f*ck are you reading this? This game isn't for kids FFS).

If your save had 300-320 NPCs on start - after a few days it would be a 370. Week later = 400... And a two-three weeks later = >500 (And DO thank god for not OVER9000!)
And guess what? Sometimes they spawn with a Ship! Or, if unlucky - on a derelict (I'm serous... I've seen like 5 of those dead ships with "Crew:1" stat. And no, It wasn't a corpses)! 
And with "Fire in the hold" They even get some Tin Cans with a guns! And even fight each-other! Does it somehow impacts your gameplay? 
Only if you're near Ceres WITH your ship but let's be honest - Unless using a PASS there isn't any good way to get to Ceres Quickly and Safely. 
And so there's a whole cacophony of "Creations" is happening like... Everywhere! Ships get created, destroyed, wrecked. Rooms appear and disappear. NPCs appear, travel, choke on the "acceptable algae" and get dragged into the local Valhalla. Sometimes a Pirate or just someone "not from the hood" spawns in and Whole Royal Cavalry of Seasoned OG's runs toward It to ROYALLY Wreck his mug (Watch out for trigger-happy cops!)! 

Oh! And every NPC also Eats, Sleeps, Sh*ts, each and everything you know, except maybe like.... Doing Work? Because in space everyone only Brags about their 12/12(both AM)/7, but keeps watching Drama reruns [i](Except Techies, though... They got two additional madskillz: "FIX-ZE-ZTUFF" and "IDGAF ABT UR SHIP GIMME UR TRENCHIES!"... I mean really... I had to put a Code on my pantry AND Galley doors to stop those "Elements" from ransacking my food/water reserves)[/i] for days and Getting Pissed off by a chair, why? Because he's an uncomfortable plastic b*tch, disallowing anyone reliably relax their ass more that two times in a row! It's even more funny as Game's wiki has a reference on the Rimworld's table behaviour... Uhhh... how do they say it? People who live in glass houses shouldn't throw stones? 

And guess what? Your PC has to emulate [Sseth Tzeenach Voice] "ALL OF THIS SH*T", constantly and Simultneously! No mercy! No exceptions! "Be there or be Square, because you're not around!" - That's the motto of this game's simworks!
Oh and rest assure - 90% of that "content" WILL happen OUTSIDE of your reach(Without debug magic) and you know... I think all those quests that many Steam/Reddit players will suggest you not even touch aren't actually bugged... Or at least they wasn't in the first place. Let me cite the classics: [b]"Truth is... the game was rigged from the start."[/b]
It's just the Simulation itself has screwed you up before you could even realize that. 
How? Killing(Figuratively or literally... or sometimes - Both ways at once) an Quest-related NPC and Erasing it from existence ofc!
[i](P.s. THere is a rumor about the Corpse-room... and I'm prettty sure it's the K-Leg's OKLG-UNC... at least when I did a purge there was like... 70 or 90 Dead NPCs on that loc! So yeah... They did it. They did the meme - "Yes, 'Delete' him, and from the Trash bin too".)[/i]

And this is the Main fun-killer of the whole game! Other systems are simply UNDER-developed to present any issues at all or simply stuck in their primitive implementations, without any further development! It's just the fact that your Game tries to Simulate the WHOLE F**KING solar system of various'level deadbeats! And unlike "Shadows of Doubt" which has a finite number of NPCs the Ostranauts decided to have an different approach... 
(And I even suspect the Devs do actually aspire to reach the same numbers of ~1000 fully simulated active NPCs, with a few hundreds of a "Frozen spares", ready to substitute I'm afraid)


Unfortunately there's a limit of how much you can write, so check comments for the remaining part...
items.text_zh:
[h1]一款试图成为它永远无法成为的东西的游戏。[/h1]

[b]警告[/b]：[i]下面所说的一切都是我主观意见的一部分；我可能在评论的某些部分高估了游戏理念，甚至暗示开发者有什么4D超级战略招式的胡言乱语；这没关系。这是我在真正开始深入游玩后从游戏中得到的印象的一部分。[/i]


我见过各种各样的游戏……有些没碰过，但肯定见过。
有些专注于像Stationeers那样的LSS维护。
有些专注于像Space Engineers或Empyrion那样在你的飞船上建造、飞行和战斗。
有些专注于旅行和（快速）掠夺方面，比如Pulsar:LC、Duskers或Scavenger SV-4。
有些专注于超自然/惊悚的东西，比如VotV或Isolated Inhale……
我也很喜欢Sunless Sea以及它的续作Sunless Skies……
还有一款所谓“完美模拟”的样本，就是Shadow of Doubt……

所以，我在这里列出所有这些游戏的原因是，有时候即使你知道自己在做什么，实现其中哪怕一个方面都很难，然而这款游戏的开发者们，没有多少相关经验，仍然决定尝试把所有这些都结合到一起……

[i]蓝色。瓶子。[/i]


老实说，我写这篇评论肯定已经写了两个多星期了，但我仍然不确定我能否完全表达我对……
呃……这么说吧——一切的失望。

而最悲剧的是，这不是糟糕代码的错（也许？）、可疑选择的错（或许？），或者对项目本身态度的错（完全不是？我猜）。
所有糟糕的东西都来自游戏本身……字面意义上是因为它在设计上的构想；让我解释一下……
你知道衔尾蛇是什么吗？对，那条自噬的蛇，实际上不能吃自己之类的，好吧……这款游戏字面上就是它。
只不过它确实把自己吞噬得很好……首先，让我告诉你在这款游戏里你会怎样度过游戏时间：
前30分钟会不错，一切都会像光一样快速轻松……
然后第二个30分钟来了……你会开始注意到轻微的问题——微卡顿、几秒钟“思考”、加速时卡顿……
然后到了卢比孔河——一个半小时后游戏会变得很难玩……缓慢，有时冻结……
最终它会逐渐停摆。你会发现自己盯着游戏，每“响应”一分钟就要花十分钟处于“未响应”状态……最终你只能杀掉进程，等十秒钟，重启游戏（可能还要重启一半的应用，因为游戏会持续吞噬你的内存，远远超过16Gb中的12Gb，你的电脑肯定会开始发疯，试图通过把所有“未使用”的东西放进“暂停”状态来减轻负担，包括Steam。）然后循环重新开始。

“为什么会这样？我们怎么修复它？开发者为什么不修复它？”——你大概问过这些问题，而查看resmon不会满足你好奇的头脑，除非你读日志。
没错，他们为之牺牲其他一切的“完美模拟”野心反噬了他们自己的屁股。

所以……你还记得你是怎么创建角色的吗？除非你立刻点了“寻找飞船”，选了The Retrofit并离开角色创建（如果你这是第二个角色，那就是走向死亡。如果你是职业玩家，那就是走向荣耀。）——游戏通常会吐出一堆与你成长经历相关的NPC……势利眼、警察、暴徒、傻瓜……朋友或敌人，简而言之就是“一整副牌”。
你猜怎么着？每个生成的NPC某种程度上确实会经历同样的流程！不，他们不会像你一样自闭地盯着镜子（那面镜子上次见到清洁工大概还是它被制造出来的时候）……
但他们确实会“掷骰”人生……还有一大把跟班！而且他们也会有自己的……然后一次又一次又一次，直到碰到某种限制器，但是（是的，有个讨厌的“但是”！大概还有一整帮“但是”！）这个“限制器”似乎……这么说吧，有时候他/她(?)会请[strike]一天假[/strike]整整产假——NPC偶尔会像兔子一样繁殖，那些兔子吞下了一整箱“成人化学品”……你懂的（如果你不懂……那你他妈为什么在读这个？这游戏不是给小孩的，天哪）。

如果你的存档开始时只有300-320个NPC——几天后就会变成370。一周后=400……两三周后=>500（感谢上帝没有超过9000！）
你猜怎么着？有时候他们生成时带着一艘飞船！或者，如果不走运——在一艘废弃船上（我是认真的……我见过大概5艘那种带有“船员：1”属性的死船。不，那不是尸体）！
而且有了“货舱起火”，他们甚至还能得到一些带枪的锡罐！甚至互相打起来！这会以某种方式影响你的游戏吗？
只有当你带着飞船在谷神星附近时才会，但说实话——除非使用通行证，否则没有快速安全到达谷神星的好办法。
所以一整套“造物”的杂音正在发生，就像……到处都是！飞船被创造、被摧毁、被毁坏。房间出现又消失。NPC出现、旅行、被“可接受的藻类”噎住，然后被拖进当地的瓦尔哈拉。有时候一个海盗或者只是某个“不是本地人”的人生成进来，然后一整支经验丰富的老兵皇家骑兵队就会冲过去把他的脸狠狠地揍烂（小心那些动不动就开枪的警察！）！

哦！而且每个NPC也会吃、睡、拉，你知道的一切，除了也许……工作？因为在太空里每个人都只吹嘘他们的12/12（都是上午）/7，却一直看戏剧重播[i]（不过技术人员除外……他们有两个额外的疯狂技能：“修东西”和“我才不管你的飞船呢，把你的内裤给我！”……我是说真的……我不得不在我的食品储藏室和厨房门上装密码锁，才能阻止那些“分子”洗劫我的食物/水储备）[/i]好几天，还会因为一把椅子而生气，为什么？因为它是个不舒服的塑料婊子，不允许任何人可靠地放松屁股超过连续两次！更好笑的是游戏的wiki还引用了Rimworld的桌子行为……呃……他们怎么说来着？住在玻璃房子里的人不该扔石头？

你猜怎么着？你的电脑必须模拟[Sseth Tzeenach声音]“所有这些狗屎”，持续且同时！没有怜悯！没有例外！“要么在场，要么就滚，因为你不在场！”——这就是这款游戏模拟工程的座右铭！
哦，放心——那90%的“内容”都会发生在你触及不到的地方（没有调试魔法的话），而且你知道……我觉得那些Steam/Reddit玩家会建议你甚至不要碰的任务其实并不是有bug……或者至少一开始不是。让我引用经典：[b]“真相是……游戏从一开始就被操纵了。”[/b]
只是模拟本身在你意识到之前就已经把你搞砸了。
怎么搞的？杀掉（比喻或字面意义上……有时两者同时）一个任务相关的NPC，并把它从存在中抹除，当然！
[i]（附注：有个关于尸体房的传闻……我很确定那是K-Leg的OKLG-UNC……至少我清理那里时有大概……那个地点有70或90个死NPC！所以没错……他们做到了。他们玩了这个梗——“是的，'删除'他，还要从垃圾桶里删”。）[/i]

这就是整个游戏的主要乐趣杀手！其他系统开发得太不充分，根本不会造成任何问题，或者只是停留在原始实现上，没有任何进一步发展！事实就是你的游戏试图模拟整个他妈的太阳系里各种级别的废物！而且不像“Shadows of Doubt”有有限数量的NPC，Ostranauts决定采取不同的方法……

items.text: The devs don't care about a good game. They care about making the features they want. They don't care about the user experience. They have an antagonistic view toward the players. I played the game enough to see the bones of a really fun game. I stopped playing when I saw the meat was rotting before it had even hit 1.0. CTD bugs, sub-60 FPS, and unplayable quests (not bad, unplayable, as in they brick your save) are unacceptable for a 1.0. Unless they fix those, do not buy the game.
items.text_zh: 开发者不在乎做出好游戏。他们只在乎做自己想要的功能。他们不在乎用户体验。他们对玩家抱有敌意。我玩得够久，看到了一个真正有趣游戏的骨架。当我看到这肉在还没到1.0之前就已经腐烂时，我就停止游玩了。CTD崩溃bug、低于60帧的帧率，以及无法游玩的任务（不是差，是无法游玩，意思是它们会毁掉你的存档），对于1.0版本来说是不可接受的。除非他们修复这些问题，否则不要买这游戏。

items.text:
This is a game that is just compelling enough to get you to waste your time.

The game isn't done. Rarely will you even be able to do basic tasks in the starter area without the game breaking catastrophically. The good aspects of the game are compounded by half-baked time wasting excersizes. When it does get going, many things don't work; NPCs don't work, dialogue doesn't work, orders don't really work, timelapse doesn't work, plotting a course doesn't work, etc. Like, tell me a normal-ass Oblivion-style dialogue system wouldn't just be better than what's here?

When you are just scrapping a hull for valuable parts and everything is working as intended, it sure is fun, don't get me wrong. I'm all for confusing systems, but they have to work. NeoScavenger was good. They bit off more than they could chew with this one unfortunetly.

Edit: I havent played that many hours of the game, I just left it on. Anyways, I have found the way that this game crashes and breaks the most is with the pathing. Remove things from your ship that cause the path to break, don't hire crewmembers except if you need them and directly order them around (then fire them), and avoid using haul orders and orders in general, as they cause the pathing to break. If you don't think it's gonna work, don't try it; the game visibly stutters when trying to find a path to an order even under the best circumstances. Don't engage with bugged NPCs, you will have to reset your computer this game crashes so bad. 1.0 "release" my ass. Learn how to use the debug. Lucky I am used to playing broken games lol.

If you are really really really into games like this (like I unfortunetly am...) than go for it I guess. You will be fighting the game the whole time.
items.text_zh:
这是一款刚好足够吸引人、让你浪费时间的游戏。

这游戏还没做完。你甚至很少能在起始区域完成基本任务而不让游戏灾难性地崩溃。游戏里好的方面被半生不熟、浪费时间的练习给拖累了。当它真正运转起来时，很多东西都不管用；NPC不管用，对话不管用，命令不太管用，时间流逝不管用，规划航线不管用，等等。就像，你告诉我一个普普通通的《湮灭》风格的对话系统难道不会比这里的东西更好吗？

当你只是在拆解一艘船体以获取有价值的部件，而且一切都按预期运作时，那确实很好玩，别误会我。我完全支持复杂的系统，但它们必须得能运作。《新拾荒者》就很好。不幸的是，他们在这款游戏上贪多嚼不烂。

编辑：我并没有玩那么多小时，我只是把它开着而已。总之，我发现这款游戏崩溃和出问题最多的方式是在寻路方面。从你的飞船上移除那些会导致路径中断的东西，不要雇佣船员，除非你需要他们并直接指挥他们（然后解雇他们），并且避免使用搬运命令以及一般命令，因为它们会导致寻路中断。如果你觉得它不会成功，就别试；即使在最好的情况下，游戏在尝试为一条命令寻找路径时也会明显卡顿。不要与有bug的NPC互动，你会不得不重启你的电脑，这游戏崩溃得太厉害了。1.0“正式版”个屁。学会怎么用调试模式吧。幸好我习惯了玩有问题的游戏，哈哈。

如果你真的真的真的非常喜欢这类游戏（就像我不幸地那样……），那我想你就去玩吧。你会全程都在跟这游戏作斗争。

items.text: Last time I played i was  in the docking process to K-Leg, when suddenly a short circuit lead to a fire. I stood up from the navigation console, put on my space suit and killed the fire. Finally I made it. Two seconds later i crashed into the station and was dead.... I just love those kinds of stories. I agree, the UI could have a little overhaul and I also got mild frame drops (didn't reach the endgame yet) here and there, but when I play a game for 50+ hours and had fun with it, I just can't give a negative review. cheers

items.text:
This a perfect simulator of dystopian spaceship salvager. You are a slave to the corporation, and every story out there is your own: when you undock from the station and go to scrap your first derelict freighter or your hundredths, anything can happen or nothing can happen and every adventure is your own. The game is very addicting and not hand holdy. You are left to your own devices, and you can solve many problems by thinking outside the square. I highly recommend this hidden gem for anyone that wants a challenging and rewarding experience. When you come home after work and fire this one up you will feel a great deal of satisfaction when you cobble together your own ships from bits of space junk and weld it together with a bit of spit and good luck and go off on a lightyear adventure to explore the unknown. Maybe go mine asteroids, maybe go fight spare pirates. Anything is possible. It’s your own path out there, go and explore. 10/10

Edit: the game is full of bugs, quest system doesn't work that well and optimisations is bad, game lags a lot when performing multiple tasks. These are small thins, what the game lacks in quality in makes up tenfold in gameplay. But yes, negative reviews have valid points.
items.text_zh:
这是一个完美的反乌托邦飞船打捞模拟器。你是公司的奴隶，而那里的每一个故事都是你自己的：当你从空间站解缆出发，去拆解你的第一艘废弃货船，或者你的第一百艘时，任何事情都可能发生，也可能什么都不发生，每一次冒险都是你自己的。这游戏非常上瘾，而且不手把手教你。你被放任自流，你可以通过跳出框框思考来解决许多问题。我强烈推荐这个隐藏的宝石给任何想要挑战性和有回报体验的人。当你下班回家后启动这款游戏，当你用太空垃圾碎片拼凑出自己的飞船，用一点唾沫和好运把它焊接在一起，然后出发去进行一场光年冒险探索未知时，你会感到极大的满足。也许去开采小行星，也许去和零散的太空海盗战斗。一切皆有可能。那是你自己的道路，去探索吧。10/10

编辑：游戏充满了bug，任务系统运作得不太好，优化也很差，执行多项任务时游戏会严重卡顿。这些都是小事，游戏在质量上的欠缺在玩法上弥补了十倍。但没错，负面评论有合理的观点。

items.text:
Ostranauts is a mechanically pleasing game to play.
It isn't without its issues in it current form, but the simplified orbital mechanics used for spaceflight, or the almost dungeon crawl feel of the salvaging loop, and even the almost meditative Tetris-like feel of the inventory management are a solid foundation for the game to stand on as the game gets ready to leave Early-Access and hit its 1.0 release.

One of the biggest issues with the game, in my mind, is the game's economy. Specifically once you get a solid grasp on the value of equipment and loose items, much of the difficulty and struggle goes away. The Character generation system can also seem intimidating at first, and unless you go min/max-ing your character will likely be more fragile than expected, but its also perfect for setting the tone of the game. There are of course some code inefficiencies and jank you can expect from the game, but the devs have been hard at work ironing out what they can.

The upcoming 1.0 release promises expanded story content, more places to visit, and exciting new features like a bounty hunting system to expand on the existing gameplay. Most importantly, the game's associate discord is well managed and friendly with devs, mods, and experienced players on hand though most parts of the day to answer questions of lend a hand dealing with the less obvious game mechanics.

I encourage you to read more reviews, good, and bad, or watch some of the excellent gameplay content from established youtubers. Ostranauts may seem intimidating at first, but its very possible that it may just be your next gameplay obsession.
items.text_zh:
《Ostranauts》是一款在机制上令人愉悦的游戏。
以目前的形式来看，它并非没有问题，但用于太空飞行的简化轨道力学，或者打捞循环中那种近乎地牢爬行的感觉，甚至库存管理中那种近乎冥想般的俄罗斯方块式体验，都为这款游戏在准备脱离抢先体验并迎来1.0正式发布时奠定了坚实的基础。

在我看来，这款游戏最大的问题之一是它的经济系统。具体来说，一旦你扎实掌握了装备和散落物品的价值，大部分难度和挣扎就会消失。角色生成系统起初也可能显得令人生畏，除非你对自己的角色进行极限优化，否则角色很可能比预期更脆弱，但它也非常适合为游戏定下基调。当然，你也能预料到游戏中有一些代码效率低下和粗糙之处，但开发者们一直在努力打磨他们能处理的部分。

即将到来的1.0发布承诺带来扩展的剧情内容、更多可访问的地点，以及令人兴奋的新功能，比如赏金狩猎系统，以扩展现有玩法。最重要的是，游戏相关的Discord管理良好且氛围友好，开发者、版主和经验丰富的玩家在一天中的大部分时间都在线，可以回答问题或帮忙处理那些不太明显的游戏机制。

我鼓励你阅读更多评论，无论好评还是差评，或者观看一些知名YouTuber制作的优秀玩法内容。《Ostranauts》起初可能显得令人生畏，但它很可能正是你下一个沉迷的游戏。

Really long loading times, super buggy AI, lack of content in certain areas and a lot of gameplay systems serve little purpose. There is also little QoL. The game concept is interesting, but the potential remains wasted due to a very rushed 1.0 release after which i can only guess there will be no more large content updates.  This game required at least 1 year more in the oven, but oh well.

The developers and their community are allergic to criticism and ban anyone who points it out. Very unprofessional and childish.

This game doesn't value your time and the studio does not value your input. Stay away. There are far better places to spend your money.

items.text:
Its a tragedy this game is being released at 1.0 shortly. It needs a LOT more time to cook. The ideas are so phenomenal but the execution is just not there as things are. Basic functions in the game don't work reliably. AI is broken to the point where its easier and safer to just manually do everything instead of giving orders. Either that or get ready to reload the save because your auto-tasked character walked out into the vacuum of space without putting on their helmet, while you're in the middle of a salvage. Okay so full manual control it is. Except the art direction and UI make every moment a fight to do what you need to. The missions are bugged and randomly disappear. The performance is awful, even on a beefy computer. None of these would be deal breakers but apparently the game is being released as 'feature complete' in days. There is no way all the major issues are addressed in a few days when it hasn't happened over the years this has been in EA. 

It pains me to be so critical because there is currently nothing out there trying to do what this game is. Underneath all the issues is my dream space sim- one where you can pilot your own ship (complete with tactile switches and knobs), build and tinker with various parts, trade, fight, and basically just RP living in the Firefly universe.
items.text_zh:
这个游戏即将在1.0版本发布，真是个悲剧。它需要更多时间来打磨。想法非常出色，但就目前的情况来看，执行根本不到位。游戏中的基本功能无法可靠运行。AI坏到了极点，以至于手动做所有事情比下达命令更容易也更安全。要么就准备好重新加载存档，因为你自动分配任务的角色没戴头盔就走进了太空真空，而你正在打捞中途。好吧，那就完全手动控制吧。但美术方向和UI让每一刻都变成了一场为实现目标而进行的战斗。任务有bug并且会随机消失。性能很糟糕，即使在性能强劲的电脑上也是如此。这些都不是致命问题，但显然游戏几天后就要以“功能完整”的状态发布了。多年来在EA阶段都没能解决的问题，不可能在几天内全部解决。

如此苛刻地批评让我很痛苦，因为目前没有任何游戏在尝试做这个游戏所做的事情。在所有问题之下，是我梦想中的太空模拟游戏——一个你可以驾驶自己的飞船（配有触觉开关和旋钮），建造和修补各种部件，贸易，战斗，基本上就是在《萤火虫》宇宙中角色扮演生活。
