items.text:
To many bugs and inconsistency in the game you go to uninstall a wall in the center of your ship next thing you know the wall stays the floor goes along with the conduit and your pressurized space. if your docking and less than 10 seconds away from hard dock a patrol ship can literally force a hard dock then spin your ship 37000 km away into empty space. Not to mention random meteor strikes that hit the same location six times. Not to mention buggy conversations the auto build not being able to find the parts when you took the time to place them in neat little stacks right next to the build site. 

After a reboot and update and starting a new game some of the problems went away it still on occasions does odd things with the patrol ship docking the last instance was I could not get the officer to leave my ship after coming back from prison the said officer sent me to. I installed a exercise device and he would not stop using it.

 I would only recommend Ostranauts to people who have a high tolerance for figuring things out on there own and dealing with frustration well is a must. This is not space engineers, with years of videos and help files. Others may want to wait till the truly adventurous figure out things and write help files and video there solutions.

After playing for over 120 hrs I can honestly say that Ostranauts is a game the is hard to get a good read on there is so much possibility with what could be. Its defiantly staying on my ssd as the loading between almost docking and docking can jar my system in to being unresponsive for 4 to 5 seconds its the same for any action that changes the point of view.

I will close the wall of text by saying frustrations and bugs aside I cant stop playing.

After 134 hours of play and many frustrations, with many hours spent building up a ship from a tin can of almost certain death to a stable and great cargo caring life sustaining titan, I must admit I am done till the next patch, the only suggestion I would give is to fire your crew the minute they kill them self's doing something stupid, its going to happen and its morbid but hay its ether that or pay a corps. 

I am back at it as of the last update opt in and I have to say the new game play additions and more involved reactor construction has me hooked again. Still when you get in to the later stages of the game the lag issues and the control issues it causes can be quite frustrating still the progress on the game is great. Still not for the faint of heart or easy to frustrate.

I have to say the game has greatly improved to the point I can suggest it to the slightly space realism addicted persons such as my self. the only thing I can say needs work is the save system after a save there is a pause that is very hard to miss and can lead to a miss click read as oops there goes that wall. The pause also occurs during docking but its not as critical after you get used to docking.
items.text_zh:
游戏里有太多bug和不一致之处，你去拆掉飞船中央的一堵墙，结果接下来你会发现墙还在，地板却连同管道和你加压的空间一起没了。如果你在对接时距离硬对接不到10秒，一艘巡逻船可以硬生生强行硬对接，然后把你的飞船旋转到37000公里外的空旷太空中。更别提随机陨石撞击会六次击中同一个位置。更别提有bug的对话，自动建造在你花时间把零件整齐地堆放在建造点旁边时却找不到它们。

在一次重启和更新并开始新游戏后，一些问题消失了，但它偶尔仍会在巡逻船对接时做出奇怪的事情，最后一次是我无法让那名军官离开我的飞船，那是在从监狱回来后，正是那名军官把我送进去的。我安装了一个锻炼设备，他就一直用个不停。

我只会向那些对自行摸索事情有很高容忍度、并且必须能很好应对挫败感的人推荐Ostranauts。这不是《太空工程师》，没有多年的视频和帮助文件。其他人可能想等到真正有冒险精神的人弄清楚事情并写出帮助文件和视频解决方案。

在玩了120多个小时后，我可以诚实地说，Ostranauts是一款很难准确评价的游戏，它有着太多可能成为的样子。它绝对会留在我的固态硬盘上，因为几乎对接和对接之间的加载会让我的系统卡住4到5秒无响应，任何改变视角的操作也是如此。

我将以这句话结束这堵文字墙：撇开挫败感和bug不谈，我停不下来。

在玩了134小时并经历了许多挫败之后，我花了很多小时把一艘几乎必死的铁皮罐头飞船建成一艘稳定、出色的运货、维持生命的巨舰，我必须承认，在下一个补丁之前我不玩了，我唯一能给的建​​议就是，当你的船员做蠢事害死自己时，立刻解雇他们，这种事会发生，虽然很病态，但嘿，要么这样，要么付钱给尸体。

随着最近一次选择加入的更新，我又回来了，我不得不说，新的玩法添加和更复杂的反应堆建造让我再次上瘾。不过，当你进入游戏后期阶段时，延迟问题及其导致的操控问题仍然相当令人沮丧，但游戏的进展很棒。仍然不适合胆小的人或容易被激怒的人。

我不得不说，游戏已经大大改进，到了我可以把它推荐给像我这样稍微对太空写实上瘾的人的程度。我唯一能说需要改进的是存档系统，存档后会有一个很难错过的暂停，可能导致误点被当成哎呀那堵墙没了。暂停也会在对接时发生，但在你习惯对接后就没那么关键了。

items.text:
Update 15/02/25 (American: 02/15/25):
Since this review, some of these issues have been addressed, while others still remain.

Improvements:
- Crew AI is a little more flexible than it used to be, with some basic priorities for task categories. Crew are more useful than goldfish now, but you will still need to babysit them a little
- NPCs no longer suffocate themselves (mostly)
- Crashes are much more uncommon (although not rare)
- A much more living world. Long-distance travel (and reasons to do so) has since been added, and it's quite satisfying.
- It's down from 80% of time spent fighting bugs to nearly 0%, even in the current test build. Although 65% is still spent fighting design mechanics.

Persistent issues:
- Performance. It's playable on most PCs, but it really chugs. Loading times between zones break immersion frequently
- Inventory management. With a little finesse, you can get a working system set up for salvaging, but you'll always be doing it on the game's terms, not your own. Get ready for a lot of micromanagement.
- AI intelligence. Crew will fetch items one by one, with little concern for efficiency. They follow a very simple series of instructions, in the order you give them, so you'll need to spend about 5 hours learning how to trick them into working the way you want them to and doing the bulk of the menial tasks manually. This is probably the area most ripe for improvement.

Overall, bugs are being crushed, content is expanding (albeit slightly), and core mechanic choices remain a persistent thorn in an otherwise singular game.

It's still a not-recommend for me in its current state, but development progression is promising, so keep an eye on this. Give it another year; it's still heading for an easy recommend.

-------------------

It's a great deal of fun. The fundamental game loop is enjoyable, and the community is quite active (albeit only on discord and not on Steam, which is kind of sus). Plus the developer is reasonably renowned (neo scavenger was excellent, although relatively more barren in content than its system is innovative. I'm hoping Ostranauts won't reach a similar apex).

Once it's in a proper Beta state, this will be an EASY recommend.

However, in its current state, it's exceptionally clunky, buggy, and unrefined.
- Crew AI doesn't offer much yet. They're not much more than liabilities at the moment. But it's more enjoyable if you imagine them as pet goldfish.
- NPCs have a great range of needs, which is nice, but it's more than their current AI is able to respond to. NPCs will suffocate themselves in their own suit; stand at the airlock trying to get to a TV on the station (which you've disallowed them from entering) instead of going to your very nice rec room; and are generally very confused about what they can and can't do.
- Task and hauling management is unreliable and inefficient, it's faster to do everything manually. You can set zones for items, but the UI options are highly limited and auto-hauling seems to exist (because I find items randomly moved around the ship), but I have no idea by what logic. You'll need to manually select items to be hauled and hope you've set up your zones to be close enough to what you want. You can set construction orders and set your crew to automatically build it, but: they will collect items one by one as they build them. And good luck trying to get a crew to handle tasks collaboratively: more often than not, they just make it harder for each other to get anything done.
- And the usual list of bugs you'd expect from a complex game in Alpha, causing you to resort to debug menus, off-and-on, and loading earlier saves.

Overall, it has fantastic potential. It should be in your wishlist and follow list, and ranked amongst the top of them.
Devs are focusing on feature development more than stability, so it's a fun time if (like me), you don't mind working through a bunch of jank to play with some cool toys.

If you want to enjoy the experience, check back in a year. This is a classic early-access title.
If you're willing and able to spend 80% of your game time fighting against bugs and clunky mechanics, come and join!
items.text_zh:
更新于 15/02/25（美式：02/15/25）：
自这篇评测以来，其中一些问题已经得到解决，而另一些仍然存在。

改进：
- 船员 AI 比以前稍微灵活了一些，对任务类别有一些基本的优先级。船员现在比金鱼更有用，但你仍然需要稍微照看他们
- NPC 不再让自己窒息了（大多数情况下）
- 崩溃变得少见多了（尽管并不罕见）
- 一个更加鲜活的世界。远距离旅行（以及这样做的理由）此后已被加入，而且相当令人满意。
- 从花 80% 的时间与 bug 搏斗降到几乎 0%，即使在当前的测试版本中也是如此。不过仍有 65% 的时间花在与设计机制搏斗上。

持续存在的问题：
- 性能。它在大多数 PC 上都能玩，但确实很卡。区域之间的加载时间经常破坏沉浸感
- 物品栏管理。稍加技巧，你就能为打捞建立一个可用的系统，但你始终是在按游戏的规则行事，而不是你自己的。准备好面对大量的微观管理吧。
- AI 智能。船员会一件一件地取物品，几乎不考虑效率。他们遵循一系列非常简单的指令，按你给出的顺序执行，所以你需要花大约 5 个小时学习如何诱使他们按你想要的方式工作，并手动完成大部分琐碎任务。这大概是最有待改进的领域。

总体而言，bug 正在被消灭，内容正在扩展（尽管幅度不大），而核心机制的选择仍然是一根持续存在的刺，扎在这款在其他方面独一无二的游戏里。

就目前的状态而言，对我来说仍然是不推荐，但开发进展很有希望，所以请继续关注这款游戏。再给它一年时间；它仍然有望轻松获得推荐。

-------------------

它非常有趣。基本的游戏循环令人愉快，社区也相当活跃（尽管只在 Discord 上而不在 Steam 上，这有点可疑）。此外，开发者相当有名（《新拾荒者》非常出色，尽管其内容相对而言比其系统的创新性更为贫瘠。我希望《Ostranauts》不会达到类似的顶峰）。

一旦它进入正式的 Beta 状态，这将是一款轻松推荐的作品。

然而，在目前的状态下，它异常笨拙、bug 多且未经打磨。
- 船员 AI 目前还提供不了太多东西。此刻他们不过是负担而已。但如果你把他们想象成宠物金鱼，就会更有趣一些。
- NPC 有种类繁多的需求，这很好，但这超出了他们当前 AI 所能应对的范围。NPC 会在自己的宇航服里把自己闷死；站在气闸处试图去够空间站上的一台电视（而你已经禁止他们进入那里），而不是去你非常漂亮的娱乐室；而且总体上非常搞不清自己能做什么、不能做什么。
- 任务和搬运管理不可靠且低效，手动做所有事情反而更快。你可以为物品设置区域，但 UI 选项极其有限，而且自动搬运似乎存在（因为我发现物品在飞船里被随机移动），但我完全不知道它是按什么逻辑运作的。你需要手动选择要搬运的物品，并祈祷你设置的区域足够接近你想要的效果。你可以设置建造订单并让船员自动建造，但是：他们在建造时会一件一件地收集物品。而且，祝你好运，试着让船员协作处理任务：大多数情况下，他们只会让彼此更难完成任何事情。
- 还有你在 Alpha 阶段的复杂游戏中会预料到的那一长串常见 bug，迫使你时不时地求助于调试菜单，并反复加载较早的存档。

总体而言，它有着极佳的潜力。它应该在你的愿望单和关注列表里，并且排在其中的前列。
开发者更专注于功能开发而非稳定性，所以如果你（像我一样）不介意克服一堆毛病来玩一些很酷的东西，那会是一段有趣的时光。

如果你想享受这段体验，请一年后再回来看看。这是一款典型的抢先体验作品。
如果你愿意并且能够把 80% 的游戏时间花在与 bug 和笨拙机制搏斗上，那就来加入吧！
任何事情都做完了。

总体而言，它有着极佳的潜力。它应该出现在你的愿望单和关注列表中，并且名列前茅。

At the moment, Ostranauts is fun enough but not without its problems:

-    It's buggy. Yeah. However, the experienced developers have put in a number of debug options to repair the game in the event of anything game-breaking.

-    The user interface is pretty underwhelming. Selecting things in the environment is a chore... if you can find it in the first place. Then, you need to click on an action at the bottom of the screen. The actions are thin buttons that you slowly scroll through. If the game is not paused, the buttons frequently shove past each other. Annoying.

-    The game is slow. Everything takes precious, precious time. I'm talking both game-play and the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ memory allocation or whatever the hell is happening in the background. It's like the poor game is getting hit on the head with a lead pipe every 20 seconds.

-    A lot of the elements are (currently) quite shallow. Socialising is instantly noticeable. The conversations are downright lunacy. There is very little agency in a conversation and it's ultimately pointless, outside of hiring crew or getting busted without a permit. Plots, gigs and combat are very boring at the moment and are essentially "click this, click that".

It's worth it if you can sustain mental punishment from VERY unfinished games but the average person will actually loathe this in its current state.
items.text_zh:
目前来说，Ostranauts 已经足够有趣，但并非没有问题：

-    它有很多漏洞。是的。不过，经验丰富的开发者们加入了许多调试选项，以便在出现任何破坏游戏的问题时修复游戏。

-    用户界面相当令人失望。在环境中选择东西是件苦差事……前提是你能先找到它。然后，你需要点击屏幕底部的动作。这些动作是细长的按钮，你需要慢慢滚动浏览。如果游戏没有暂停，这些按钮经常会互相挤过去。烦人。

-    游戏很慢。一切都需要花费宝贵、宝贵的时间。我指的是游戏玩法以及♥♥♥♥♥♥♥内存分配或者后台发生的什么鬼事情。就像这个可怜的游戏每20秒就被一根铅管敲一下脑袋。

-    很多元素（目前）都相当肤浅。社交方面立刻就能注意到。对话简直是疯了。对话中几乎没有自主权，而且最终毫无意义，除了雇佣船员或者无证被抓之外。剧情、任务和战斗目前都非常无聊，本质上就是“点这个，点那个”。

如果你能承受来自非常未完成游戏的精神折磨，那它还是值得的，但普通人实际上会讨厌它目前的状态。

Not bad, there is a lot of promising stuff here. This could become a great game like nothing else.
BUT!
This game is still very decidedly early access. Bugs, weird behaviour from NPCs, items, ships, atmosphere simulation. Performance issues, frequent and severe lagspikes. Clunkly UI. A lot of features are still yet to be added.
So the current state of the game is playable and fun for a while, but it has a long way to go before its full potential is realized.

items.text:
So far it is great. It is a work in progress but gets regular feature updates and hotfixes. I love the retro-futuristic clunky aesthetics similar to the Alien universe (a.k.a. cassette futurism apparently!). Artwork and soundtrack (so far) is amazing. Character creation, traits/skills, "select your own adventure novel" type prologue and writing in general are very smart and introduce the universe very well. Immersion is amazing. Recently added combat is tense and consequential, just like Neo Scavenger. Content is currently limited; but it already has much more playtime potential than many fully released games, and that is what early access is for.

Some feedback on the problems I see:

- I dread sleeping. I love how the game is real life but that means if your character is solo and go to sleep, with a maximum x16 fast forward option available, you need to stare to the screen for 22,5 minutes doing nothing to get a 6-hour sleep. This is the game encouraging to go afk instead of you know, play the game. There needs to be a "sleep for x hours" option that makes that time pass by instantly.

- Dialogue and npc interactions are a bit weird. It might be a deliberate design choice, but you just find anyone breathing and spam some specific options to get your specific mood meters improved. But apparently your mood meters also go down with the replies you got and/or a dialog "tick", neutralizing your improvement. This forces the player to get in a human bundle and spam that dialogue option with multiple people to get ahead of the tick. It is not explained and not fun at all. It might be a placeholder system though.

- Performance needs to be improved. You need to frequently get into debug mode and "prune npcs" to be able to play without lag spikes. I know they are working on this, and the latest hotfix should be about it. I will edit this item later if lag spikes get significantly less common. Keeping the debug menus and the "rescue" option of the ship available at least in Early Access is very smart by the way.

- I haven't tried myself but apparently crew npc ai is not very smart. Working solo seems to be the way until further updates.

As of writing this, it is well worth the price, and it deserves to be supported in my opinion.
items.text_zh:
到目前为止，它很棒。它还在开发中，但会定期获得功能更新和热修复。我喜欢类似《异形》宇宙的那种复古未来主义的笨重美学（显然又叫磁带未来主义！）。美术和配乐（到目前为止）都很惊艳。角色创建、特质/技能、“选择你自己的冒险小说”式的序章以及整体的文笔都非常巧妙，很好地引入了这个宇宙。沉浸感极佳。最近加入的战斗紧张且后果重大，就像《新拾荒者》一样。目前内容有限；但它已经比许多完全正式发布的游戏拥有多得多的可游玩时间潜力，而这正是抢先体验的意义所在。

关于我看到的问题，一些反馈：

- 我害怕睡觉。我喜欢这款游戏贴近现实，但这意味着如果你的角色是独自一人去睡觉，而可用的最大快进选项是x16，你就需要盯着屏幕无所事事地看22.5分钟，才能睡满6个小时。这是游戏在鼓励你挂机，而不是，你知道的，去玩游戏。需要一个“睡x小时”的选项，让那段时间瞬间过去。

- 对话和NPC互动有点奇怪。这可能是有意的设计选择，但你只要找到任何一个活人，然后狂刷某些特定选项来提升你特定的心情值。但显然你的心情值也会因为你得到的回复和/或一次对话“结算”而下降，抵消了你的提升。这迫使玩家扎进人堆里，对多个人狂刷那个对话选项，才能跑赢那个结算。这一点没有得到解释，而且一点都不好玩。不过这可能只是一个占位系统。

- 性能需要改进。你需要频繁进入调试模式并“修剪NPC”，才能在没有卡顿峰值的情况下游玩。我知道他们正在处理这个问题，最新的热修复应该就是关于这个的。如果卡顿峰值明显变得不那么常见，我之后会编辑这一条。顺便说一句，至少在抢先体验期间保留调试菜单和飞船的“救援”选项，是非常聪明的做法。

- 我自己还没试过，但显然船员NPC的AI不太聪明。在后续更新之前，独自行动似乎才是正道。

在写这篇评测时，它完全值这个价，而且在我看来，它值得得到支持。

observations.evidence_zh: 性能需要改进。你需要频繁进入调试模式并“修剪NPC”，才能在没有卡顿的情况下游玩。

I've been playing this pretty much since it first came out - and i don't know whether to be amazed or disgusted at how the Devs have turned this game from being Fairly Playable to BARELY Playable! I know that I'm amazed that they've managed to make a Single Player, NON Online game with a level of Lag so fierce that i can press an action key, go and make a cup of coffee, come back and the avatar is STILL not moving. At one point there were something like 40 NPC sprites on the screen - and talk about a freeze! At this point - i would not recommend this game UNTIL these problems are resolved.
UPDATE: 2025 annnd... yep, game still bites. yay, they fixed the NPC lag. but NOW someone decided to "improve" the navigation controls... so you're going nowhere. AND for some reason my avatar keeps dying in a controlled environment. Pity really, I can see the good points to this game, buuuuut... the BAD points overrule.

UPDATE 2026: Dunno if the devs listened or what, but DAMN YES! MUCH improved, VERY Playable, 10 stars Blue Bottle Games.

UPDATE April 2026: HOLY SNAPPING DUCKSHIT, DEVMAN! Talk about turbocharged! Love the far more viewable graphics, the Ship Controls are FARQWIN AWESOME, all new bits to add to your craft.... Devs? GOLDEN BUZZER!

我几乎从这款游戏刚出来就一直在玩——我不知道该对开发者把这款游戏从“相当可玩”变成“勉强可玩”感到惊叹还是恶心！我知道我很惊叹，他们居然能把一款单人、非在线游戏做出如此猛烈的延迟，以至于我可以按下一个操作键，去冲杯咖啡，回来之后角色仍然没有动。有一次屏幕上大概有40个NPC精灵——更别说那卡顿了！就目前而言——在这些问题解决之前，我不推荐这款游戏。
更新：2025年，然后……是的，游戏还是很烂。耶，他们修复了NPC延迟。但现在有人决定“改进”导航控制……所以你哪儿也去不了。而且不知为什么，我的角色一直在一个受控环境中死亡。真可惜，我能看到这款游戏的优点，但……缺点压过了优点。

2026年更新：不知道开发者是不是听了意见还是怎样，但该死的，是的！改进太多了，非常可玩，10颗星，Blue Bottle Games。

Update 9/8/2024: After talking with numerous people on the game's official Discord, I realize that the previously mentioned issues appears to be something to do with the game specifically not liking my AMD Ryzen 7950X and Nvidia RTX 4900 running on Linux. For that reason, I'm giving the game a thumbs up. It is really sad to me that this is the only game (out of ~200+ I have played on Linux) that has this particular issue, but it is what it is. For reference, disabling FSYNC and ESYNC via Proton environment variables does get the game to ~30 FPS.

Update 11/29/2023: Unfortunately performance of the game is still very poor and almost unplayable on Linux/Wine/Steam Deck. It seems like there's something happening with the game engine that, when pressing play, immediately switches the game to 20 FPS instead of 60 FPS on Windows. Developer should really investigate this issue. Linux gamers love nerdy games like this!

Update 7/27/2023: Unfortunately two poor developments have happened since my initial review. First, the game is now virtually unplayable on Linux/Wine/Proton. I'm getting 60 FPS on Windows, but on Proton, on various Linux distros, I'm getting 20 FPS. Second, the game is suffering from memory leaks that is hurting performance massively. I'm hoping the developer will promptly address this, as I'm sure many Linux gamers are interested in playing as well.

For that reason, I cannot recommend this game to anyone playing on Linux or with Steamdeck until the developer addresses the performance.

If the developer implements fixes to performance, I will update!

Original review: Incredible game that shows endless potential. It's, admittedly, a little rough around the edges. You will experience bugs and odd behavior. You will probably be confused about what you're supposed to do or yearn for more documentation. Despite the challenges, the scaffolding for what's here and what's to come is really exciting. Happy to support the growth of this game.

items.text: Good game if you love to role play but overall gameplay is just choose your starting skills and traits then maybe get screwed by an adventure then buy a ship by 40 years or sooner. Then buy permit if you have enough money and if not go scrap ship then repeat and maybe get beat up by law enforcement for illegal stuff. items.text:
Entertaining, for early access.
-Fun to learn while dying type game
-Awesome character generation, repeats after a few times
-Fixing/building your ship is fun while it is breaking down
-Cops coming for you to check on your license is funny
-Crew social is very interesting, buggy, but interesting

Really needs a lot more work though - bugs from 1/12/23:
-After visiting a few derelicts and having a lot of stuff on your ship, it will start becoming choppy/low fps
-The orders management is cool, yet fails/crashes a lot
-Inventory UI is horrible, cannot change the size of the huge text, you accidentally click off one of the tiny inventory boxes you move, which is both annoying and sometimes rarely useful
-Social UI is horrible, cannot change the size of the small text
-Trade UI is horrible, have to scroll every time you open a sub-list
-Esc key, escapes everything except right click menu
-The crew will constantly interrupt you, repair a hole in the hull, doesn’t matter
-No good way to get crew to stop interrupting aside from mod, which removes it completely
-Crew will constantly go outside without helmets and die lock doors if you could get all the codes
-Crew dying on another ship, you cannot drag them to your ship, fire them and leave them to die (or extra eva suit)
-Cops will ram you
-Bugs/lacking in many ship systems, airlocks are almost pointless since you cannot automate them and lose air fast. (sure you can manually vacuum the space, but the manual controls are full screen for a tiny panel and a just get annoying after a while)
-Nav station won’t list all door codes, and you have guess which door is which code
-Lots of skills are useless, some do a little, 4 of them do a lot
-Making money/economy is weird - you can get a lot of stuff, but cannot sell it all. If you have a loan, you will be bogged down in bills, store refreshes every 4 shifts, but you have to pay the loan every shift... So you get the ship that doesn't have a loan and then it becomes pointless
-Yeah you can jettison stuff.... one at a time.... 100s of trash.... ugh

Wishes: 
-multiplayer, or at least better crew. 
-Easy way to make ships and add them to the game without modding. 
-Simple switch automation (at least a proximity switch)
-By the time you find the Cart, you really don’t need the cart
-Simple crafting - cart, change 02 sensor to N2, cart, blue light to red light, cart

Tldr: After 100+ hours played, the bugs will beat you into not wanting to play this awesome game. Worth $20, yea
items.text_zh:
在抢先体验阶段，这游戏挺有意思的。
- 边死边学的那种游戏，很好玩
- 角色生成很棒，但重复几次后就腻了
- 飞船一边坏一边修/造还挺有趣的
- 警察来查你的执照很好笑
- 船员社交非常有意思，有bug，但有意思

不过真的还需要大量打磨——截至23年1月12日的bug：
- 访问了几艘废弃飞船、船上东西多了之后，游戏会开始卡顿/掉帧
- 命令管理系统很酷，但经常失效/崩溃
- 物品栏UI很糟糕，没法调整巨大文本的大小，你移动那些小物品栏格子时一不小心就会点到外面，既烦人又偶尔有点用
- 社交UI很糟糕，没法调整小文本的大小
- 交易UI很糟糕，每次打开子列表都得滚动
- Esc键，什么都能退出，就是退不出右键菜单
- 船员会不停地打断你，哪怕是在修补船体上的破洞，也一样
- 除了用mod（而且mod会把它完全移除）之外，没有好办法让船员停止打断你
- 船员会不停地不戴头盔就跑到外面去然后死掉，如果能拿到所有密码的话倒是可以把门锁上
- 船员在另一艘船上死了，你没法把他们拖到你的船上，只能解雇他们、任他们去死（或者多备一套EVA服）
- 警察会撞你
- 许多飞船系统有bug/不完善，气闸几乎毫无意义，因为你没法自动化它们，而且漏气很快。（当然你可以手动给空间抽真空，但手动控制是一个小面板却占满全屏，过一会儿就让人烦）
- 导航站不会列出所有门的密码，你得猜哪个门对应哪个密码
- 很多技能没用，有些有点用，有4个技能作用很大
- 赚钱/经济系统很奇怪——你能搞到很多东西，但没法全卖掉。如果你有贷款，你会被账单压得喘不过气，商店每4个班次刷新一次，但你每个班次都得还贷款……所以你就只能选那艘没有贷款的船，然后贷款系统就变得毫无意义
- 是啊，你可以把东西扔出去……一次一个……几百件垃圾……唉

愿望：
- 多人模式，或者至少把船员做好点。
- 有简单的方法造船并把它们加进游戏，不用做mod。
- 简单的开关自动化（至少来个接近开关）
- 等你找到购物车的时候，你其实已经不需要购物车了
- 简单的合成——购物车，把O2传感器换成N2，购物车，把蓝灯换成红灯，购物车

长话短说：玩了100多个小时之后，这些bug会把你折磨到不想再玩这款超棒的游戏。值20美元，是的

it genuinely cant be recommended in this state.  ive had items go into a black hole on my ship when moving things with shift[causing unplayable lag], ive had the transit hubs break down and refuse access [effectively trapping you isolated pockets on a station]  ive had police officers flag me down for illegal ship ripping only for them to get back in their chair and fly my ship into a old wreak at 900 meters/s instantly breaking everything, ive been moving in to dock at the station only for the game to freeze up while the ship is barely moving, for it to unfreeze and ram it into the docking platform so hard it ripped several holes in the walls on very far distance locations[ on a fairly large ship]

that one is actually really annoying, ive messed up and crashed at substantially faster speeds and never even had a hull breach

, causing the equivelant of approximatley 20minutes of idle repairs [actual time in a sped up speed] 

but they do seem to listen to feedback. i remember an older version where it didnt really feel like your in space, removing floor felt like removing your ability to even move around a station/ ship. now you can actually fly over empty tiles and against the ship itself without a floor 

its just got too many big problems for you to enjoy  a good time

items.text:
EDIT3: I parked this game for a GOOD long time and recently came back to try to figure out the 1.0 version of the game.  I will state that there is clearly a lot of work to do, and I'm hopeful the team sticks to it.  Their prior titles have been stellar.  But I'm not so sure the title deserves the 6.1 stars it's currently rocking.  The experience of 1.0 HAS been noticeably better than my first 40 hours.  So much so I put 3 hours in in a single session having a good time.  The UX IS still pretty intimidating and definitely needs more polish, but it HAS come a long way since last played.  So I'd say it's more of a 7.5/10 stars right now for me.  Let's give it some more time in the simmer pot and see what we end up with!

EDIT2: The game is much more playable as of my last 30 or so hours played since last update.  This game is getting so very good and the news about Kitfox gives me even more excitement about what will undoubtedly be an absolutely legendary title in my library 20 years from now!

EDIT: After a very interactive and positive experience with one of the developers on Discord showing genuine interest in helping me with my problem, I'm going to flop this to thumbs up.  I STILL caution you about the state of the game, however.  This could very well be a frustrating experience for you if you're looking for high sheen polish.

I truly believe the full release of this game is going to be a remarkable experience.

The devs are making frequent meaningful updates and while they ARE adding features and content the focus SEEMS to be on bug squashing, AI improvement and stability.  Which is smart, because what little I've played I get a sense that only about 25% of all the systems that are in the game UI are actually even implemented and it's a terrible idea to advance content when stability is still as unpleasant as it is on this game.  And because of that, I'm excited and hopeful for the future of this title.  I'm also a huge fan of Neo Scavenger.  I rarely reinstall old games after I shelve them the first time and NEO Scavenger is a very rare exception to that.  I just really appreciate the survival experience they put together in that game.

However, this game is still in an unplayable state, at least for me.  It constantly stalls between 5-30 seconds, often invoking Windows to tell me it's not responding (to which I tell it 'give it a few more seconds' and it always comes back).  I get constant stalls when doing nothing but walking, and they're especially frustrating in space flight.  My Ryzen 9 3900X, 32GB Ram and RTX3080GPU should be able to run this at 60fps without a single hitch, but sadly it's constantly fluctuating between 15-60 fps, when it's not completely stalling for much longer.  It's unplayable for me.

I'm essentially a $20 kickstarter backer without anything to play.  Which is ok for me but for some it may not be, which is why I'm doing the thumbs down.  Once this game patches up to playable for me I'll flop the thumb to up, but right now it's going back on the digital shelf.
items.text_zh:
编辑3：我把这款游戏搁置了很长一段时间，最近回来试着弄清楚游戏的1.0版本。我要说，显然还有很多工作要做，我希望团队能坚持下去。他们之前的作品一直很出色。但我不太确定这款游戏是否配得上它目前所拥有的6.1星。1.0版本的体验确实明显比我最初的40小时要好得多。好到我一次游戏就投入了3个小时，玩得很开心。用户体验仍然相当令人望而生畏，肯定需要更多的打磨，但自从上次玩以来已经有了很大的进步。所以我会说，现在对我来说更像是7.5/10星。让我们再给它一些时间在炖锅里慢慢熬，看看最终会得到什么！

编辑2：自从上次更新以来，我玩了大约30个小时，游戏的可玩性大大提高。这款游戏变得越来越好，关于Kitfox的消息让我更加兴奋，毫无疑问，20年后它将成为我游戏库中一款绝对传奇的作品！

编辑：在Discord上与一位开发者进行了非常互动且积极的交流，他表现出真诚的兴趣来帮助我解决问题，所以我打算把差评改成好评。不过，我仍然要提醒你注意游戏的状态。如果你追求高度精致的打磨，这很可能会给你带来令人沮丧的体验。

我真心相信这款游戏的完整发布将会是一次非凡的体验。

开发者们正在频繁地进行有意义的更新，虽然他们确实在添加功能和内容，但重点似乎放在修复bug、改进AI和稳定性上。这是明智的，因为就我玩的那一点点来看，我感觉游戏UI中所有系统中实际上只有大约25%被真正实现了，而在稳定性仍然如此令人不快的情况下推进内容是个糟糕的主意。正因为如此，我对这款游戏的未来感到兴奋和充满希望。我也是Neo Scavenger的超级粉丝。我很少在第一次搁置旧游戏后重新安装它们，而NEO Scavenger是一个极其罕见的例外。我真的很欣赏他们在那个游戏中打造的生存体验。

然而，这款游戏仍然处于无法游玩的状态，至少对我来说是这样。它不断卡顿5到30秒，经常触发Windows告诉我它没有响应（对此我会告诉它“再给它几秒钟”，它总是会恢复）。我在只是走路什么都没做的时候就会不断卡顿，在太空飞行时尤其令人沮丧。我的Ryzen 9 3900X、32GB内存和RTX3080 GPU应该能够以60fps运行这款游戏而毫无卡顿，但遗憾的是，它不断在15-60fps之间波动，有时候还会完全卡住更长时间。对我来说这没法玩。

我基本上就是一个花了20美元的Kickstarter支持者，却没什么可玩的。这对我来说还好，但对一些人来说可能不是，这就是我给差评的原因。一旦这款游戏修补到对我来说可以玩的程度，我就会把差评改成好评，但现在它要回到数字货架上了。

items.text:
[h1] An interesting concept but still pretty underwhelming. [/h1]
I picked up this game recently after hearing good things and after seeing its steam page i spent the 15 pounds for what i hoped was a full experience.
Is it worth it? Maybe in the future but currently not.

[u] The Positives [/u]
So far whats here is pretty fleshed out, the little that that might be.
The stylistic choices when it comes to the game feels great. The menus feel in setting and fleshed out and the guide books and posters really immerse you into the setting, wrapping your head around everything the first time felt like a real learning experience. My first hour was spent smiling and being genuinely surprised by some of the depth in whats here, even something as simple as the helmet overlay when you put on the pressure suit was genuinely surprising to me. The amount of detail put into the little things that are there were surprising, many of them you wouldn't expect from a small developer like this one.

One thing that's surprisingly fleshed out for a game like this is the character interaction and creation system, i'm not going to get into it in depth here (mostly because i'm not really 100% on how it works myself) but the character creation itself has just enough to make you genuinely invested in your character.

[u] The negatives [/u]
My main issue with the game is it's lack of things you'd expect for a space wreck survival and exploration game, as well as the many many bugs I experienced whilst playing.
The game is currently a laggy mess. i've experienced more technical issues than actual challenges from the game itself. there's very little in the game so far and most of it is spiced with "jank". The most threatening thing i've come to so far is being softlocked by the patrol ships and being unable to escape, as they continue to dock you and crash into your ship.
A few of the bugs that keep breaking my experience:
- Being unable to command my character to act on anything whilst unpaused
- Being continuously docked and then ignored by the officers in patrol ships
- having weird nameless NPCs just appear in the back of my ship for no reason
- being stuck on the weird title card page because i pressed the button too fast

On-top of all the bugs, there really isn't enough to get you to spend the £15 on it. what's here is fleshed out, but it's still missing that spark, and the game-play loop is pretty repetitive from what i can tell.

Would i recommend the game: maybe, once it's ironed itself out.
items.text_zh:
[h1] 一个有趣的构思，但仍然相当令人失望。[/h1]
我最近在听说了好评之后入手了这款游戏，看到它的 Steam 页面后，我花了 15 英镑，希望能获得一次完整的体验。
它值这个价吗？也许将来值，但目前不值。

[u] 优点[/u]
到目前为止，这里已有的内容相当充实，尽管可能并不多。
游戏在风格上的选择感觉很棒。菜单很有代入感且内容充实，指南手册和海报真的让你沉浸在这个设定中，第一次弄明白一切时感觉像是一次真正的学习体验。我的第一个小时是在微笑中度过的，并且对这里的一些深度内容感到真心惊讶，甚至像穿上压力服时头盔覆盖层这样简单的东西都让我真心感到意外。那些存在的小细节所投入的用心令人惊讶，其中许多是你不会指望像这样的小型开发者能做出的。

对于这样一款游戏来说，有一件事出人意料地充实，那就是角色互动和创建系统，我不打算在这里深入展开（主要是因为我本人也不完全确定它是怎么运作的），但角色创建本身的内容刚好足以让你真正投入到自己的角色中。

[u] 缺点[/u]
我对这款游戏的主要不满在于，它缺少你在一款太空残骸生存与探索游戏中所期待的东西，还有我在游玩过程中遇到的许许多多 bug。
这款游戏目前就是一坨卡顿的烂摊子。我遇到的技术问题比游戏本身带来的实际挑战还多。游戏目前内容很少，而且大部分都带着“粗糙感”。到目前为止，我遇到的最具威胁的事情，就是被巡逻船软锁住、无法逃脱，因为它们不断对接你并撞上你的飞船。
一些不断破坏我体验的 bug：
- 在未暂停时无法命令我的角色对任何事物采取行动
- 被巡逻船不断对接，然后又被船上的军官无视
- 莫名其妙地有奇怪的无名 NPC 出现在我飞船的后部
- 因为按按钮太快而卡在奇怪的标题卡页面

除了所有这些 bug 之外，真的没有足够的内容让你愿意为它花这 15 英镑。这里已有的内容是充实的，但仍然缺少那点火花，而且据我所知，游戏循环相当重复。

我会推荐这款游戏吗：也许吧，等它把自己理顺之后。
